blocks.title: 英語の目標と方針
blocks.md:
- この教材の大問番号・配点・目標点は練習用の設計です。2026年度の本番の構成は直近の問題用紙で確認し、偏差値はその回の換算で確認してください。
- 目標は**偏差値62**。北辰の英語は平均点が50点前後になることが多く、**初見の過去問を時間内に解き、その回の換算で到達を確認**します。
- ばらつきが出る原因は「文法の穴」「長文の読み方が固まっていない」「英作文で白紙・減点」の3つ。この教材はその3つを**型**で固めます。
- 毎日の順番：**単語セット（10分）→ 文法ユニットまたは大問別演習 → リスニング（演習または音読）**。英語は毎日、最初にやりましょう。

blocks.title: 解く順番と時間の見切り
blocks.md:
- 放送が終わったら **大問2 → 大問5の英作文 → 大問3 → 大問4** の順がおすすめ。英作文は「型」で書けるので、先に確実に取ります。
- 1つの設問で**2分以上止まったら印をつけて次へ**。最後に戻る。
- 大問4の会話文は長いので、**設問を先に読んで**「何を探すか」を決めてから本文を読みます。

blocks.title: 進め方のコツ
blocks.md:
- **GW（弱点ユニットの再学習）**の日は、G0診断テストや模擬テストで間違えた文法ユニットをもう一度やります（要点を読み直し、演習の間違えた問題だけ解く）。
- **LS（音読・シャドーイング）**は、前回やったリスニング原稿を声に出して読む10分。「聞こえる耳」を維持する一番安い方法です。
- **R2R・LX・WX・RR** は「解き直し」。○がついた問題はやらず、×だけをやります。

blocks.title: やり方
blocks.md:
- 辞書を見ずに解く。わからない問題は空らんのままでOK（それが「弱点の発見」です）。
- 答え合わせのあと、**間違えた問題の右にある「→G△」のユニットを、GWの日の再学習リストに書き出す**。

blocks.title: 問1　（　）に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい。【各1点】
blocks.question_md:
問1　（　）に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい。【各1点】
1. My brother (　) soccer every Sunday.　ア play　イ plays　ウ playing　エ played　→G1
2. There (　) a lot of children in the park yesterday.　ア is　イ are　ウ was　エ were　→G1
3. I (　) TV when my mother came home.　ア watch　イ watched　ウ was watching　エ am watching　→G2
4. We (　) visit Kyoto next month.　ア are going to　イ going to　ウ went　エ are go to　→G2
5. You (　) be tired. You worked all day.　ア can　イ must　ウ has to　エ may not　→G3
6. Do you know (　)?　ア where does he live　イ where he lives　ウ he lives where　エ where lives he　→G4
7. I want (　) a doctor in the future.　ア be　イ being　ウ to be　エ to being　→G5
8. Thank you for (　) me.　ア help　イ to help　ウ helping　エ helped　→G5
9. It is important (　) us to learn English.　ア of　イ to　ウ for　エ with　→G6
10. My father let me (　) his camera.　ア use　イ to use　ウ using　エ used　→G6
11. This question is (　) than that one.　ア difficult　イ more difficult　ウ most difficult　エ the most difficult　→G7
12. Tom is the (　) of the three.　ア tall　イ taller　ウ tallest　エ most tall　→G7
13. I'll stay home if it (　) tomorrow.　ア rains　イ will rain　ウ rain　エ rained　→G8
14. I think (　) he is right.　ア what　イ that　ウ if　エ when　→G8
15. This picture (　) by my sister last year.　ア painted　イ was painted　ウ is painting　エ paints　→G9
16. English (　) in many countries.　ア speaks　イ is spoken　ウ is speaking　エ spoke　→G9
17. I (　) in this town since I was five.　ア live　イ lived　ウ have lived　エ am living　→G10
18. They have been (　) tennis for two hours.　ア play　イ played　ウ playing　エ to play　→G10
19. Have you (　) been to Hokkaido?　ア ever　イ never　ウ yet　エ already　→G11
20. I have (　) finished my homework.　ア yet　イ already　ウ ever　エ since　→G11
21. My friends call (　) Ken.　ア I　イ my　ウ me　エ mine　→G12
22. The news made her (　).　ア happy　イ happily　ウ happiness　エ to happy　→G12
23. The girl (　) the piano is my cousin.　ア plays　イ playing　ウ played　エ to play　→G13
24. This is a letter (　) in English.　ア write　イ writing　ウ written　エ wrote　→G13
25. Would you like (　) tea?　ア some　イ any　ウ a　エ many　→G14
26. I have (　) money, so I can't buy it.　ア a few　イ few　ウ a little　エ little　→G14

問2　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。【各1点】
27. 私は彼に何と言えばよいかわからなかった。 I didn't know ( to / what / him / say ).　→G6
28. 向こうで走っている少年は私の弟です。 The ( boy / over / running / there ) is my brother.　→G13
29. 彼女は私に写真を見せてくれました。 She ( me / showed / pictures / some ).　→G12
30. 私はこの本を3回読んだことがあります。 I ( read / this / have / book ) three times.　→G11

| 4 | ア | be going to＋動詞の原形 | 19 | ア | 疑問文の「今までに」は ever |
| 5 | イ | 「〜にちがいない」must | 20 | イ | 肯定文の「もう」は already |
| 6 | イ | 間接疑問は「疑問詞＋主語＋動詞」 | 21 | ウ | call＋目的語＋名前 |
| 7 | ウ | want to＋原形 | 22 | ア | make＋目的語＋形容詞 |
| 8 | ウ | 前置詞のあとは動名詞 | 23 | イ | 現在分詞の後置修飾「弾いている少女」 |
| 9 | ウ | It is … for 人 to … | 24 | ウ | 過去分詞の後置修飾「書かれた手紙」 |
| 10 | ア | let＋人＋動詞の原形 | 25 | ア | Would you like some …? |

sections.title: 文の基本（be動詞・一般動詞・三単現・命令文・There is）
sections.heading: G1　文の基本（be動詞・一般動詞・三単現・命令文・There is）
path: 1　文法ユニット（前半：G1〜G8）
G1　文の基本（be動詞・一般動詞・三単現・命令文・There is）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**① be動詞（am / is / are、過去は was / were）**：「〜です／〜にいる」。主語とセットで決まる。
- I **am** / You **are** / He, She, It **is** / We, They **are**。過去：I, He, She, It → **was**、You, We, They → **were**。
- 否定は be動詞のあとに not（isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't）。疑問は be動詞を前に出す。

**② 一般動詞**：主語が **3人称単数（he, she, it, 人の名前、this…）で現在形**なら動詞に **-s / -es**（三単現）。
- play → plays、watch → watch**es**、study → stud**ies**、have → **has**、go → go**es**。
- 否定・疑問は **do / does / did** を使い、動詞は**原形**に戻す：He does**n't** play. / Did you go?

**③ 命令文**：動詞の原形で始める。「〜しないで」は **Don't** ＋原形。「〜しましょう」は **Let's** ＋原形。ていねいに言うなら **Please**。
- Be quiet. / Don't run here. / Let's go.

**④ There is / are**：「〜がある／いる」。あとの名詞が単数なら is、複数なら are。過去は was / were。
- There **is** a cat under the chair. / There **are** two cats. / **Is there** a park near here? — Yes, there is.

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 三単現の s は**北辰で最も多い減点**。主語が he / she / it / 人名 / 単数の物で、現在の話なら s。**主語を見る→時制を見る**の順で確認。
- does / did のあとの動詞は**必ず原形**：Did he **went**（×）→ Did he **go**（○）。
- 「〜がある」は There is。「私は〜を持っている」は I have。日本語の「ある」につられて has を使わない。

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　（　）内から適切な語を選びなさい。**
1. My sister ( play / plays ) the piano every day.
2. Ken and I ( am / are / is ) good friends.
3. ( Do / Does ) your father like cooking?
4. She ( don't / doesn't ) eat breakfast.
5. There ( is / are ) some books on the desk.
6. ( Is / Are ) there a hospital near the station?
7. We ( was / were ) very tired last night.
8. ( Don't / Not ) open the window.

**B　（　）内の語を適切な形に直しなさい。直す必要がなければそのまま書きなさい。**
9. Tom ( study ) English at home every day.
10. My mother ( have ) a nice bag.
11. Yuki ( go ) to school by bus.
12. I ( be ) in Osaka last week.
13. Bob and Mike ( be ) in the same class last year.

**C　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。**
14. 公園には木がたくさんあります。 ( a lot of / there / trees / are ) in the park.
15. 静かにしなさい。 ( quiet / be ), please.
16. 彼はテニスをしません。 He ( play / doesn't / tennis ).
17. あなたのお姉さんは英語を話しますか。 ( your sister / speak / does / English )?

**D　英語にしなさい。**
18. 私の父は毎朝コーヒーを飲みます。（drink, coffee, every morning）
19. 私たちの町には駅が2つあります。（two stations, in our town）
20. ここで走ってはいけません。（run, here）
blocks.answer_md:
1. plays　2. are（主語は Ken and I ＝ we）　3. Does　4. doesn't　5. are（books は複数）　6. Is（a hospital は単数）　7. were　8. Don't
9. studies（y → ies）　10. has　11. goes　12. was　13. were
14. There are a lot of trees in the park.　15. Be quiet, please.　16. He doesn't play tennis.　17. Does your sister speak English?
18. My father drinks coffee every morning.　19. There are two stations in our town.（Our town has two stations. も可）　20. Don't run here.

**よくあるミス**：9 で studys にしない／13 の Bob and Mike は複数なので were／18 の drinks の s 忘れ。

sections.title: 過去形・進行形・未来（will / be going to）
sections.heading: G2　過去形・進行形・未来（will / be going to）
path: 1　文法ユニット（前半：G1〜G8）
G2　過去形・進行形・未来（will / be going to）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**① 過去形**：規則動詞は **-ed**（play → played、study → stud**ied**、stop → stop**ped**）。不規則動詞は暗記（go → went、see → saw、have → had、come → came、take → took、make → made、get → got、write → wrote、read → read〈発音レッド〉、buy → bought、think → thought、teach → taught、bring → brought、give → gave、eat → ate、run → ran、speak → spoke、leave → left、find → found、know → knew、say → said、tell → told、meet → met、send → sent、build → built、sit → sat、stand → stood、swim → swam、win → won、begin → began、break → broke、fall → fell、feel → felt、forget → forgot、hear → heard、hold → held、lose → lost、put → put、cut → cut）。
- 否定：**didn't** ＋原形。疑問：**Did** ＋主語＋原形？

**② 進行形**：be動詞 ＋ **-ing**。「〜している（現在進行形）」「〜していた（過去進行形）」。
- -ing のつくり方：run → run**ning**、swim → swim**ming**、make → mak**ing**、write → writ**ing**、study → study**ing**（y はそのまま）。
- **when** とセットで過去進行形がよく出る：I **was reading** when he **called**.（電話をかけてきたとき読んでいた）

**③ 未来**：**will** ＋原形（その場で決めた・単純な未来・「〜でしょう」）／**be going to** ＋原形（前から決めていた予定・起こりそうなこと）。
- will not ＝ **won't**。Will you …? は「〜してくれませんか」の依頼にもなる。
- 未来を表す語：tomorrow, next week, next Sunday, in the future, someday。
- **時や条件を表す接続詞（when / if / before / after）の中は、未来のことでも現在形**：If it **rains** tomorrow, I will stay home.

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 「昨日〜していた」は過去進行形、「昨日〜した」は過去形。**動作の途中なら進行形**。
- 「〜するつもりです」→ be going to、「〜するでしょう」→ will。どちらでも通じるが、並べ替えでは与えられた語で判断。
- last …, … ago, yesterday, then があれば過去形。**現在完了とは一緒に使えない**（G10で確認）。

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　（　）内の語を適切な形に直しなさい。**
1. I ( see ) a beautiful bird in the park yesterday.
2. She ( write ) a letter to her grandmother last night.
3. We ( go ) to the museum two days ago.
4. He ( study ) math for three hours last Sunday.
5. They ( swim ) in the river now.
6. My brother ( read ) a book when I came home.
7. Look! The dog ( run ) in the garden.
8. It ( be ) rainy tomorrow, so I will take an umbrella.

**B　（　）に入る適切な語を選びなさい。**
9. ( Did / Were / Was ) you watch the game last night?
10. What ( did / were / was ) you doing at seven yesterday?
11. I ( will / am ) going to visit my uncle next week.
12. If it ( is / will be ) sunny tomorrow, we will go hiking.
13. She ( didn't / wasn't ) come to school yesterday.

**C　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。**
14. 私が電話したとき、彼女は夕食を作っていました。 She ( dinner / was / cooking ) when I called her.
15. 今週末は何をするつもりですか。 ( are / what / going / you / to / do ) this weekend?
16. 明日は雪が降らないでしょう。 It ( snow / won't ) tomorrow.
17. 私は昨日その本を買いませんでした。 I ( the book / buy / didn't ) yesterday.

**D　英語にしなさい。**
18. 私は昨夜10時に寝ました。（go to bed, at ten）
19. 彼らは今、体育館でバスケットボールをしています。（in the gym）
20. 私は来年、京都を訪れるつもりです。（be going to, visit）

9. Did（watch は一般動詞）　10. were（doing があるので過去進行形）　11. am　12. is（if の中は現在形）　13. didn't（come は一般動詞）
14. She was cooking dinner when I called her.　15. What are you going to do this weekend?　16. It won't snow tomorrow.　17. I didn't buy the book yesterday.
18. I went to bed at ten last night.　19. They are playing basketball in the gym now.　20. I am going to visit Kyoto next year.

He ( study ) math for three hours last Sunday.
They ( swim ) in the river now.

sections.title: 助動詞（can, may, must, should, have to …）
sections.heading: G3　助動詞（can, may, must, should, have to …）
path: 1　文法ユニット（前半：G1〜G8）
G3　助動詞（can, may, must, should, have to …）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
助動詞は **主語に関係なく形が同じ**で、あとは**動詞の原形**。否定は助動詞のあとに not。疑問は助動詞を前に。

| 助動詞 | 意味 | 言いかえ・注意 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| can | 〜できる／〜してもよい（許可） | ＝ **be able to**。過去は could、未来は will be able to |
| may | 〜してもよい／〜かもしれない | May I …?（〜してもいいですか） |
| must | 〜しなければならない／〜にちがいない | ＝ **have to**（三単現は has to、過去は had to）。**must not**＝してはいけない（禁止）、**don't have to**＝しなくてよい |
| should | 〜すべきだ／〜したほうがよい | should not ＝ shouldn't |
| will | 〜でしょう／〜するつもり | Will you …?（〜してくれませんか） |
| would | Would you …?（〜していただけませんか） | **would like to** ＝ want to のていねい形 |
| shall | Shall I …?（〜しましょうか） / Shall we …?（〜しませんか） | Shall we …? ＝ Let's … |

**依頼・許可の表現の強さ**：Can you …? ＜ Will you …? ＜ Could you …? ＜ Would you …?（ていねい）
**答え方**：Can I …? → Sure. / Of course. / Sorry, you can't.　Shall I …? → Yes, please. / No, thank you.

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- **must not（禁止）と don't have to（不要）の違い**は毎年どこかで出る。You must not swim here.（泳いではいけない）／You don't have to hurry.（急がなくてよい）
- 助動詞は2つ重ねられない：will can（×）→ will **be able to**（○）。
- have to の疑問文は **Do you have to …?**、否定は **don't have to**。

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　（　）に入る適切な語（句）を選びなさい。**
1. You ( must / can ) be quiet in the library.（〜しなければならない）
2. I ( can't / mustn't ) swim well. I want to practice more.（できない）
3. ( May / Must ) I use your pen? — Sure.
4. You ( don't have to / must not ) touch this. It's dangerous.
5. It's Sunday. You ( don't have to / must not ) get up early.
6. He ( has to / have to ) finish the report by Friday.
7. ( Shall / Will ) we go shopping tomorrow? — Yes, let's.
8. ( Would / Shall ) you like some coffee? — Yes, please.

**B　ほぼ同じ意味になるように（　）に適切な語を入れなさい。**
9. I can play the guitar. ＝ I ( ) ( ) ( ) play the guitar.
10. You must clean your room. ＝ You ( ) ( ) clean your room.
11. Let's have lunch. ＝ ( ) ( ) have lunch?
12. I want to see the movie. ＝ I ( ) ( ) ( ) see the movie.
13. Don't speak Japanese here. ＝ You ( ) ( ) speak Japanese here.

**C　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。**
14. 窓を開けてくれませんか。 ( you / open / could / the window )?
15. 私たちは明日早く起きなければなりません。 We ( get up / to / have / early ) tomorrow.
16. 私はその日、学校に行く必要はありませんでした。 I ( go / have / to / didn't ) to school that day.
17. あなたは医者に行ったほうがいいです。 You ( a doctor / should / see ).

**D　英語にしなさい。**
18. あなたはここで写真を撮ってはいけません。（take pictures）
19. 手伝いましょうか。（Shall, help）
20. 彼女は来週、その仕事を終えることができるでしょう。（be able to, finish the work）
blocks.answer_md:
1. must　2. can't　3. May　4. must not（禁止）　5. don't have to（不要）　6. has to（三単現）　7. Shall　8. Would
9. am able to　10. have to　11. Shall we　12. would like to　13. must not（mustn't も可）
14. Could you open the window?　15. We have to get up early tomorrow.　16. I didn't have to go to school that day.　17. You should see a doctor.
18. You must not take pictures here.（You mustn't … / Don't take pictures here. も可）　19. Shall I help you?　20. She will be able to finish the work next week.

items.q: You ( must / can ) be quiet in the library.（〜しなければならない）
I ( can't / mustn't ) swim well. I want to practice more.（できない）
( May / Must ) I use your pen? — Sure.
You ( don't have to / must not ) touch this. It's dangerous.
It's Sunday. You ( don't have to / must not ) get up early.
He ( has to / have to ) finish the report by Friday.
( Shall / Will ) we go shopping tomorrow? — Yes, let's.

( Would / Shall ) you like some coffee? — Yes, please.
**B　ほぼ同じ意味になるように（　）に適切な語を入れなさい。**
I can play the guitar. ＝ I ( ) ( ) ( ) play the guitar.
You must clean your room. ＝ You ( ) ( ) clean your room.
Let's have lunch. ＝ ( ) ( ) have lunch?
I want to see the movie. ＝ I ( ) ( ) ( ) see the movie.

Don't speak Japanese here. ＝ You ( ) ( ) speak Japanese here.
**C　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。**
窓を開けてくれませんか。 ( you / open / could / the window )?
私たちは明日早く起きなければなりません。 We ( get up / to / have / early ) tomorrow.
items.a: We have to get up early tomorrow.

items.q: 私はその日、学校に行く必要はありませんでした。 I ( go / have / to / didn't ) to school that day.
items.a: I didn't have to go to school that day.

items.q:
あなたは医者に行ったほうがいいです。 You ( a doctor / should / see ).
**D　英語にしなさい。**
あなたはここで写真を撮ってはいけません。（take pictures）
items.a: You must not take pictures here.（You mustn't … / Don't take pictures here. も可）

items.q: 手伝いましょうか。（Shall, help）
彼女は来週、その仕事を終えることができるでしょう。（be able to, finish the work）
items.a: She will be able to finish the work next week.

sections.title: 疑問詞と間接疑問文
sections.heading: G4　疑問詞と間接疑問文
path: 1　文法ユニット（前半：G1〜G8）
G4　疑問詞と間接疑問文

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**① 疑問詞**：what（何）、who（だれ）、whose（だれの）、which（どちら・どれ）、when（いつ）、where（どこ）、why（なぜ）、how（どのように）。
- **How** の仲間：how many（いくつ）、how much（いくら・どのくらいの量）、how long（どのくらいの時間・長さ）、how often（どのくらいの頻度）、how far（どのくらいの距離）、how old（何歳）、how tall（どのくらいの高さ）。
- 疑問詞が主語のとき：**Who** made this cake?（語順はそのまま）→ 答え：My mother did.
- What time …?（何時に）、What kind of …?（どんな種類の）、Which … or …?（AとBのどちら）。

**② 間接疑問文**：疑問文が文の中に入ると **「疑問詞＋主語＋動詞」の語順**になる（疑問文の語順ではなくなる）。
- Where does he live? → I don't know **where he lives**.（does が消えて lives に）
- What is this? → Do you know **what this is**?
- よく使う前半：I don't know / Do you know / Please tell me / I wonder / I want to know。
- **whether / if（〜かどうか）**：I don't know **if** she will come.

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 間接疑問の**時制**：前半が過去なら中も過去に。I didn't know where he **was**.
- 「疑問詞＋to＋原形」（what to do／how to use／where to go）と混同しない。**主語があるなら間接疑問、主語がないなら to 不定詞**。
- 「あなたは〜だと思いますか」は **What do you think …?**（Do you think what …? は×）。

sections.title: 不定詞（3用法）と動名詞
sections.heading: G5　不定詞（3用法）と動名詞
path: 1　文法ユニット（前半：G1〜G8）
G5　不定詞（3用法）と動名詞

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**不定詞 ＝ to ＋動詞の原形**。3つの使い方。

| 用法 | 意味 | 例 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 名詞的用法 | 〜すること | I like **to read** books. / **To swim** is fun. / My dream is **to be** a teacher. |
| 副詞的用法 | 〜するために（目的）／〜して（感情の原因） | I went to the library **to study**. / I'm happy **to see** you. |
| 形容詞的用法 | 〜するための・〜すべき（名詞のすぐ後ろ） | I have a lot of homework **to do**. / something **to drink** |

**動名詞 ＝ 動詞の -ing 形**「〜すること」。主語・目的語・前置詞のあとで使う。
- **動名詞だけ**をとる動詞：enjoy, finish, stop, practice, keep, mind, give up（enjoy **playing**）
- **不定詞だけ**をとる動詞：want, hope, decide, plan, wish, would like, need（want **to go**）
- **どちらも可**：like, love, start, begin（like **to swim** ＝ like **swimming**）
- **前置詞のあとは必ず動名詞**：good at **swimming**、interested in **reading**、thank you for **coming**、before **eating**、without **saying**。
- **be動詞＋-ing は進行形**と区別：He is running.（走っている＝進行形）／His hobby is running.（趣味は走ること＝動名詞）

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- stop **to** 〜（〜するために立ち止まる）と stop 〜**ing**（〜するのをやめる）は意味が違う。
- 「〜するための時間」time **to** …、「〜する方法」way **to** …、「〜すべきこと」things **to do** は形容詞的用法。something / anything / nothing ＋ to ＋原形 の語順（something **hot to drink**：形容詞は間）。
- 副詞的用法「〜して（うれしい・悲しい・驚いた）」：glad / happy / sad / surprised ＋ to ＋原形。

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　（　）内の語を適切な形（to＋原形 または -ing）に直しなさい。**
1. I want ( visit ) Australia someday.
2. She enjoys ( listen ) to music.
3. We finished ( clean ) the classroom.
4. He decided ( study ) abroad.
5. Thank you for ( invite ) me to the party.
6. My brother is good at ( play ) the guitar.
7. It stopped ( rain ) an hour ago.
8. I hope ( see ) you again.

**B　下線部の不定詞の用法を、ア 名詞的用法　イ 副詞的用法　ウ 形容詞的用法 から選びなさい。**
9. I have many things __to do__ today.
10. She went to the store __to buy__ some milk.
11. __To learn__ a foreign language is not easy.
12. I was surprised __to hear__ the news.
13. Do you want something __to eat__?

**C　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。**
14. 私の夢は宇宙飛行士になることです。 My dream ( be / is / to / an astronaut ).
15. 私たちは新しい友達を作るために、そのクラブに入りました。 We ( the club / joined / make / to ) new friends.
16. 何か飲むものをください。 Please ( something / me / to / give / drink ).
17. 彼女は英語を話すことが上手です。 She ( speaking / good / is / at ) English.

**D　英語にしなさい。**
18. 私は本を読むことが好きです。（動名詞で）
19. 彼は昼食を食べるために家に帰りました。（go home, eat lunch）
20. 私には今日、やるべき宿題がたくさんあります。（a lot of homework）
blocks.answer_md:
1. to visit　2. listening　3. cleaning　4. to study　5. inviting（前置詞 for のあと）　6. playing　7. raining（雨がやんだ）　8. to see
9. ウ　10. イ　11. ア　12. イ　13. ウ
14. My dream is to be an astronaut.　15. We joined the club to make new friends.　16. Please give me something to drink.　17. She is good at speaking English.
18. I like reading books.　19. He went home to eat lunch.　20. I have a lot of homework to do today.

She enjoys ( listen ) to music.
We finished ( clean ) the classroom.
He decided ( study ) abroad.
Thank you for ( invite ) me to the party.
items.a: inviting（前置詞 for のあと）

sections.title: 不定詞の応用（It is … for A to／want A to／how to／too … to／使役 let・help・make）
sections.heading: G6　不定詞の応用（It is … for A to／want A to／how to／too … to／使役 let・help・make）
path: 1　文法ユニット（前半：G1〜G8）
G6　不定詞の応用（It is … for A to／want A to／how to／too … to／使役 let・help・make）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
| 形 | 意味 | 例 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **It is … (for A) to ＋原形** | （Aが）〜することは…だ | It is important **for us to** study English. |
| **want A to ＋原形** | Aに〜してほしい | I want **you to** help me. |
| **tell / ask A to ＋原形** | Aに〜するように言う／頼む | My mother told **me to** clean my room. / I asked **him to** open the door. |
| **疑問詞 ＋ to ＋原形** | how to（〜のしかた）、what to（何を〜すべきか）、where to（どこで〜すべきか）、when to（いつ〜すべきか） | I know **how to** use this. / I didn't know **what to** say. |
| **too … to ＋原形** | …すぎて〜できない ＝ so … that ＋主語＋ can't | He is **too** tired **to** walk. ＝ He is **so** tired **that** he **can't** walk. |
| **… enough to ＋原形** | 〜するのに十分…だ | She is old **enough to** drive.（enough は形容詞のあと） |
| **let A ＋原形** | Aに〜させてやる（許可） | My father **let me use** his car. |
| **help A (to) ＋原形** | Aが〜するのを手伝う | I **helped her carry** the boxes. |
| **make A ＋原形** | Aに（無理に）〜させる | The teacher **made us clean** the room. |

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- **It is … for A to** の「A」は目的格（for **me**, for **him**）。「〜にとって」。ただし kind / nice などの性格をあらわす形容詞は **of**：It is kind **of** you to help me.
- want to（自分がしたい）と want A to（Aにしてほしい）を区別：I want **to** go.／I want **you to** go.
- let / make / help のあとは **to をつけない原形**。北辰9月範囲で追加された項目なので、並べ替えで狙われる。
- too … to の書きかえ「so … that … can't」は主語を補う：The box is too heavy for me to carry. ＝ The box is so heavy that **I** can't carry **it**.

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　（　）に入る適切な語を選びなさい。**

13. 私は彼にピアノを弾いてほしい。 I ( him / play / want / to ) the piano.

15. 母は私にその皿を洗うように言いました。 My mother ( to / me / wash / told ) the dishes.

19. I asked her to show me the picture.　20. My brother helped me do my homework.（helped me to do も可）

sections.title: 比較（比較級・最上級・as … as）
sections.heading: G7　比較（比較級・最上級・as … as）
path: 1　文法ユニット（前半：G1〜G8）
G7　比較（比較級・最上級・as … as）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**① 比較級「〜より…」＝ 比較級 ＋ than**／**最上級「いちばん…」＝ the ＋最上級 ＋ in（場所・範囲）／ of（複数の仲間）**

| 種類 | 原級 → 比較級 → 最上級 |
|:--|:--|
| 短い語：-er / -est | tall → taller → tallest、long、old、young、fast、high、small、large → larg**er**（e で終わる）、big → big**ger**（子音を重ねる）、hot → hot**ter**、busy → bus**ier** → bus**iest**（y → i）、easy、early、happy、pretty |
| 長い語：more / most | beautiful, difficult, important, popular, famous, interesting, useful, expensive, exciting, careful |
| 不規則 | good / well → **better** → **best**、bad → **worse** → **worst**、many / much → **more** → **most**、little → less → least |

- in ＋ 場所・集団（in my class, in Japan, in the world）／of ＋ 複数（of the three, of all, of the five）
- **much** ＋比較級（ずっと〜）：much taller。
- **like A better than B**（BよりAが好き）／**like A the best**（Aがいちばん好き）
- **Which is 比較級, A or B?**（AとBどちらが〜？）

**② as … as「〜と同じくらい…」**（間は原級）：He is **as tall as** my father. 否定 **not as … as**（〜ほど…ない）：I am **not as tall as** he (is). ＝ He is taller than I.
**③ 比較級 and 比較級**（ますます〜）：It's getting colder and colder. **one of the ＋最上級＋複数名詞**（最も〜なうちの1つ）：one of the most famous **singers**。

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 最上級の **the** 忘れ、in と of の使い分け、複数名詞（one of the best **players**）は定番の減点ポイント。
- **書きかえ**：Tom is taller than Ken. ＝ Ken is **not as tall as** Tom. ＝ Ken is **shorter than** Tom.
- 「AとBでは、どちらが〜？」は **Which … 比較級, A or B?** 人なら Who。

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　（　）内の語を適切な形に直しなさい。**
1. This bridge is ( long ) than that one.
2. Mt. Fuji is the ( high ) mountain in Japan.

4. He is the ( famous ) singer in Japan.
5. Today is ( hot ) than yesterday.
6. This is the ( good ) movie of all.
7. I get up ( early ) than my brother.
8. This is one of the ( beautiful ) pictures in the museum.

**B　（　）に入る適切な語を入れなさい。**
9. Ken is the tallest ( ) the three.
10. She is the best swimmer ( ) her class.
11. My bag is ( ) heavy ( ) yours.（同じくらい重い）
12. I like tea ( ) than coffee.

sections.heading: G8　接続詞（that, when, if, because, though …）

G8　接続詞（that, when, if, because, though …）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
| 接続詞 | 意味 | 例 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **and / but / or / so** | そして／しかし／または／だから | I was tired, **so** I went to bed early. |
| **that** | 〜ということ（省略できる） | I think **(that)** he is kind. / I know **(that)** you are busy. / I'm sure **(that)** … / I'm glad **(that)** … |
| **when** | 〜するとき | **When** I was a child, I lived in Osaka. ＝ I lived in Osaka **when** I was a child. |
| **if** | もし〜なら | **If** you are free, let's go out. |
| **because** | 〜なので（理由） | I stayed home **because** it was raining. → Why …? の答えにも使う |
| **though / although** | 〜だけれども | **Though** he was tired, he kept working. |
| **before / after** | 〜する前に／〜したあとで | Wash your hands **before** you eat. |
| **while** | 〜する間に | **While** I was sleeping, he called me. |
| **until (till)** | 〜まで（ずっと） | Wait here **until** I come back. |
| **as soon as** | 〜するとすぐに | I'll call you **as soon as** I get home. |
| **so … that** | とても…なので〜 | It was **so** cold **that** we couldn't swim. |

**大原則**：**when / if / before / after / until / as soon as の中では、未来のことでも現在形**。
- I'll go out **if** it **is** sunny tomorrow.（will is ではない）
- 接続詞の部分が前に来るときはコンマを打つ：When I got home, my mother was cooking.

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- that のあとは「主語＋動詞」がそろった文。I think that **he is** kind.
- because は「文＋because＋文」。Because で始めて1文で終えるのは、Why …? の答えのときだけ。
- 「〜なので」を so と because で書き分ける：**理由＋so＋結果**／**結果＋because＋理由**。
- 「〜まで」until と「〜までに」by（前置詞）は別物：**by** Friday（金曜までに）。

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　（　）に入る適切な接続詞を選びなさい。**
1. I was late for school ( because / so / if ) I got up late.
2. I got up late, ( because / so / but ) I was late for school.
3. ( If / Though / When ) I came home, my brother was watching TV.
4. ( If / Because / Though ) it rains tomorrow, we won't play soccer.
5. I know ( that / if / when ) she likes music.
6. ( Though / Because / If ) he is rich, he is not happy.
7. Please wait here ( when / until / before ) I come back.
8. It was ( so / very / too ) hot that we stayed inside.

**B　（　）内の語を適切な形に直しなさい。**
9. If it ( be ) fine tomorrow, let's go to the park.
10. I'll tell him about it when he ( come ) back.
11. I hope that she ( will / is going to ) get well soon.（どちらか1つ選ぶ）
12. Brush your teeth before you ( go ) to bed.

**C　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。**
13. 私は彼が親切だと思います。 I ( kind / that / think / is / he ).
14. 私は子どものとき、犬をこわがっていました。 ( a child / was / I / when ), I was afraid of dogs.

17. 私は家に着いたらすぐにあなたに電話します。 I'll call you ( as / I / soon / as / get ) home.

**D　英語にしなさい。**
18. 私は雨が降っていたので、家にいました。（because）
19. 私は彼が正しいと確信しています。（sure）
20. 彼女はとても速く走ったので、電車に間に合いました。（so … that, catch the train）

13. I think that he is kind.　14. When I was a child, I was afraid of dogs.　15. If you have time, please help me.　16. Though he was tired, he kept studying.　17. I'll call you as soon as I get home.
18. I stayed home because it was raining.　19. I'm sure that he is right.（I am sure he is right. も可）　20. She ran so fast that she caught the train.（she could catch も可）

G9　受け身（be動詞＋過去分詞）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**受け身「〜される／〜されている」＝ be動詞 ＋ 過去分詞（＋ by 〜）**
- 現在：is / am / are ＋過去分詞　　過去：was / were ＋過去分詞　　未来・助動詞：will be ＋過去分詞、can be ＋過去分詞
- This room **is cleaned** every day. / The letter **was written** by Soseki. / The work **will be finished** tomorrow.
- 否定：be動詞のあとに not（is not used）。疑問：be動詞を前に（**Was** this picture **taken** by you?）。
- **by 〜（〜によって）**は「だれがしたか」が大事なときだけ。一般の人（people）なら省略。

**能動態 → 受動態の書きかえ**：目的語を主語に／動詞を be＋過去分詞に／もとの主語を by 〜に。
- Many people **visit** the temple. → The temple **is visited** by many people.

**by 以外の前置詞を使う受け身**：be known **to**（〜に知られている）、be made **of**（材料が見てわかる：of wood）、be made **from**（見てわからない：from milk）、be covered **with**（〜でおおわれている）、be interested **in**、be surprised **at**、be filled **with**。
**過去分詞の形**：規則動詞は -ed（過去形と同じ）。不規則動詞は3つ目の形（write–wrote–**written**、speak–spoke–**spoken**、take–took–**taken**、give–gave–**given**、see–saw–**seen**、eat–ate–**eaten**、know–knew–**known**、break–broke–**broken**、build–built–**built**、make–made–**made**、read–read–**read**、find–found–**found**、hold–held–**held**、sell–sold–**sold**、teach–taught–**taught**）。

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 「主語が〜する」のか「〜される」のかを日本語で確認。**主語がモノで動詞が他動詞なら受け身**が多い：This book **is sold** in that store.
- 疑問詞つき：**When was** this temple **built**?／**What language is spoken** in Brazil?
- 助動詞つき受け身：**can be seen**（見られる）、**must be done**（されなければならない）。

G10　現在完了①（継続）・現在完了進行形

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**現在完了 ＝ have / has ＋過去分詞**。「過去に始まったことが今とつながっている」ときに使う。
**① 継続「ずっと〜している」**：**for**（〜の間：for two years）、**since**（〜から：since 2020 / since I was a child）とセット。
- I **have lived** in Saitama **for** ten years. / She **has been** busy **since** last week.
- 疑問：**How long have you** lived here?（どのくらいの間）→ For ten years. / Since 2016.
- 否定：have **not**（haven't）／has **not**（hasn't）。

**② 現在完了進行形 ＝ have / has been ＋ -ing**：「ずっと〜し続けている」（動作の継続を強調）。
- It **has been raining** since this morning. / They **have been playing** soccer for two hours.
- know / live / like / want / have（持っている）などの状態動詞は進行形にしない → 現在完了（継続）で。

**現在完了と一緒に使えない語**：yesterday, last week, … ago, when 〜?（はっきりした過去の一点）→ 過去形を使う。

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- for と since の区別：**期間なら for、起点なら since**。since のあとは「時の一点」または「主語＋動詞（過去形）」。
- 主語が3人称単数なら **has**。
- 「〜に行ったことがある」は have **been** to（gone to は「行ってしまって今いない」）。→ G11

G11　現在完了②（経験・完了）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**① 経験「〜したことがある」**：**ever**（今までに：疑問文）、**never**（一度も〜ない）、**before**（以前に）、**once / twice / three times**（回数）、**many times**。
- I **have visited** Okinawa **twice**. / **Have you ever seen** a panda? — Yes, I have. / No, I have**n't**. / No, **never**.
- **have been to 〜**（〜に行ったことがある）：I have been to Hokkaido once. **How many times have you been to** …?

**② 完了「〜したところだ・（もう）〜してしまった」**：**just**（ちょうど）、**already**（もう：肯定文）、**yet**（疑問文「もう」／否定文「まだ」）。
- I **have just finished** lunch. / She **has already left**. / **Have** you **done** your homework **yet**? / I **haven't read** the book **yet**.
- **have gone to 〜**（〜へ行ってしまった＝今ここにいない）：He has gone to America.

**位置**：just / already / never / ever は have と過去分詞の間。yet は文末。before / once / twice も文末。

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 「経験」「完了」「継続」の見分けは**一緒に使われる語**で決まる：ever / never / times → 経験、just / already / yet → 完了、for / since → 継続。
- **been to** と **gone to** の使い分けは記号問題の定番。
- 答え方：Have you …? → Yes, I **have**. / No, I **haven't**.（Yes, I do. は×）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**① SVOO「AにBを〜する」＝ 動詞 ＋ 人 ＋ 物**
- give（与える）、show（見せる）、tell（話す）、teach（教える）、send（送る）、lend（貸す）、buy（買う）、make（作る）、bring（持ってくる）、ask（たずねる）、write（書く）
- I **gave him a present**. ＝ I gave a present **to** him.（to をつける：give, show, tell, teach, send, lend, write）
- My mother **made me a cake**. ＝ My mother made a cake **for** me.（for をつける：make, buy, cook, get, find）

**② SVOC「AをBと呼ぶ／AをBにする」＝ 動詞 ＋ 人・物 ＋ 名詞 or 形容詞**
- **call A B**（AをBと呼ぶ）：We **call him Ken**. / What do you **call this flower** in English?
- **name A B**（AをBと名づける）：They **named the dog Pochi**.
- **make A ＋形容詞**（Aを…にする）：The news **made me happy**. / This song **makes us sad**.
- **keep A ＋形容詞**（Aを…に保つ）：Keep the room **clean**.／**leave A ＋形容詞**（Aを…のままにしておく）：Don't leave the door **open**.
- **find A ＋形容詞**（Aが…だとわかる）：I **found the book interesting**.

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- SVOO の「人」は目的格（me, him, her, us, them）。give **I**（×）。
- **make** は3つの顔：make a cake（作る）、make me a cake（作ってあげる）、make me happy（幸せにする）、make me clean（させる＝使役）。「make のあとに何が来るか」で判断。
- 「AをBと呼ぶ」は名詞、「AをBにする」は**形容詞**。happily（副詞）を入れない。

blocks.title: 演習（20問）
blocks.question_md:
**A　日本語に合うように（　）内の語を並べかえなさい。**

8. 部屋をきれいにしておきなさい。 ( clean / keep / your room ).

**B　ほぼ同じ意味になるように（　）に適切な語を入れなさい。**

10. She bought her son a bike. ＝ She bought a bike ( ) her son.

20. 彼女は私に彼女の写真を送ってくれました。（send）

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**分詞 ＝ 動詞を「形容詞」として使う形**。名詞を説明（修飾）する。
**現在分詞（-ing）「〜している…」**（能動・進行の意味）

**① 1語だけなら名詞の前**：a **sleeping** baby（眠っている赤ちゃん）、a **running** dog、**falling** leaves
**② 2語以上（分詞＋語句）なら名詞の後ろ**（＝後置修飾）：
- the boy **playing soccer over there**（向こうでサッカーをしている少年）
- a girl **reading a book under the tree**（木の下で本を読んでいる少女）
- The man **talking with Ms. Green** is my father.（グリーン先生と話している男性は私の父です）

**文の骨組みを見つける**：The boy [playing soccer over there] **is** my brother. → 主語は The boy、動詞は is。分詞のかたまりは［　］に入れて考える。
**進行形との違い**：The boy **is playing** soccer.（少年はサッカーをしている＝文）／the boy **playing** soccer（サッカーをしている少年＝名詞のかたまり）

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 並べ替えでは「**名詞 → 分詞 → 残りの語句**」の順に置く。The girl **singing** a song is Yumi.
- 「〜している人・もの」は現在分詞。「〜された（〜されている）人・もの」は過去分詞（G13b）。
- 関係代名詞（who / which ＋ is … ing）と同じ意味：the boy **who is playing** soccer ＝ the boy **playing** soccer。関係代名詞は11月の範囲。

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**過去分詞「〜された…／〜されている…」**（受け身の意味）
**① 1語なら名詞の前**：a **broken** window（割れた窓）、a **used** car（中古車）、**fried** chicken、**boiled** eggs
**② 2語以上なら名詞の後ろ**：
- a letter **written in English**（英語で書かれた手紙）
- the pictures **taken by my father**（父によって撮られた写真）
- a car **made in Japan**（日本製の車）
- The language **spoken in Brazil** is Portuguese.（ブラジルで話されている言語はポルトガル語です）

**現在分詞と過去分詞の見分け**：名詞が「する側」なら -ing、「される側」なら過去分詞。
- the boy **reading** a book（少年は読む側）／the book **read** by the boy（本は読まれる側）
- **a girl called Emi**（エミと呼ばれている少女）：call の受け身

blocks.title: ここで差がつく
blocks.md:
- 過去分詞の後ろの語句は **by 〜／in 〜／at 〜**（場所・材料）が多い：a house **built** 100 years ago、a cake **made** by my mother、a picture **painted** by Picasso。
- 「〜製の」は made in ＋国（made in Japan）。
- 主語の直後に分詞のかたまりが来る文は、**動詞を見失いやすい**。［　］でくくってから動詞を探す。

G14　名詞・代名詞・冠詞・数量表現

blocks.title: 要点
blocks.md:
**① 数えられる名詞／数えられない名詞**
- 数えられない（複数形にしない・a をつけない）：water, milk, coffee, tea, bread, rice, money, paper, information, homework, music, time（時間）, work, news, advice。→ a cup of coffee / a glass of water / a piece of paper / two pieces of cake
- 複数形の注意：child → **children**、man → **men**、woman → **women**、foot → **feet**、tooth → **teeth**、mouse → **mice**、fish → **fish**、sheep → **sheep**、leaf → **leaves**、knife → **knives**、city → **cities**、box → **boxes**、potato → **potatoes**

**② 数量の表現**

| | 数えられる名詞 | 数えられない名詞 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| たくさんの | many / a lot of / lots of | much / a lot of / lots of |
| 少しの（ある） | **a few** | **a little** |
| ほとんどない | **few** | **little** |
| いくらかの | some（肯定）／any（疑問・否定） | some / any |
| 何も〜ない | no ＝ not … any | no |

- **some**は肯定文、**any**は疑問文・否定文。ただし「〜をどうぞ」と勧める疑問文は some：Would you like **some** tea?

**③ 代名詞**：I – my – me – **mine**（私のもの）、you – your – you – yours、he – his – him – his、she – her – her – hers、we – our – us – ours、they – their – them – theirs。
- **one**（同じ種類の別のもの）：I lost my pen. I have to buy **one**.／**it**（それそのもの）
- **each other**（お互い）、**one another**、**something / anything / nothing**、**everyone**（単数扱い：Everyone **is** …）
- **the other**（2つのうちのもう一方）、**another**（別のもの・もう1つ）、**others**（他の人々）

**④ 冠詞**：a（子音の音で始まる）／an（母音の音：an apple, an hour, an umbrella）／the（特定のもの、2度目に出た名詞、the sun, the first, play **the** piano）。play soccer には冠詞なし。

blocks.question_md:

14. They helped ( they ) each other.

**C　（　）に a, an, the のいずれかを入れなさい。不要なら×を書きなさい。**
15. I have ( ) dog. ( ) dog is very cute.
16. She is ( ) honest girl.
17. I usually play ( ) tennis after school.
18. Can you play ( ) violin?

blocks.title: 要点（会話文・リスニングで毎回出る表現）
blocks.md:
**① 依頼・許可・提案**
- Can you / Could you / Will you / Would you ＋原形?（〜してくれませんか）→ Sure. / Of course. / All right. / Sorry, I can't.
- May I / Can I ＋原形?（〜してもいいですか）→ Sure, go ahead. / Sorry, you can't.
- **Would you like** ＋名詞?（〜はいかがですか）→ Yes, please. / No, thank you.　**Would you like to** ＋原形?（〜しませんか）→ I'd love to.
- **How about** ＋名詞・-ing?（〜はどうですか）／**Why don't you** ＋原形?（〜したらどうですか）／**Why don't we** ＋原形?（〜しませんか）／**Shall we** ＋原形?／**Let's** ＋原形.
- **I'd like to** ＋原形（〜したいのですが）

**② 電話・買い物・道案内**
- This is Ken (speaking). / May I speak to Mr. Sato? / Hold on, please. / Can I leave a message? / You have the wrong number.
- May I help you? / I'm looking for a bag. / How much is it? / I'll take it. / Here you are. / Here's your change.
- Could you tell me the way to the station? / Go straight and turn left at the second corner. / It's on your right. / How long does it take? / It takes about ten minutes.

**③ あいづち・その他**
- I see.（なるほど）／That's right.／That's too bad.（お気の毒に）／Sounds good.（いいね）／No problem.／Never mind.（気にしないで）／What's wrong?（どうしたの）／I'm afraid …（残念ながら…）／Excuse me. / Pardon?（もう一度言って）／Take care.／Have a nice day.／Good luck.／Congratulations!（おめでとう）／Thank you for … — You're welcome. / My pleasure.

**④ 熟語（形でおぼえる）**：be interested in、be good at、be afraid of、be proud of、be famous for、be full of、be different from、be late for、be surprised at、be known to、look forward to -ing、take care of、take part in、get up、get to（〜に着く）、get on / get off、put on / take off、look for、look after、wait for、listen to、pick up、give up、find out、come true、grow up、for example、for the first time、at first、at last、in front of、on one's way to、each other、a lot of、more than、all over the world、thanks to（〜のおかげで）、because of、instead of、in the future

- 2回目も×だった問題は、**要点をノートに写して例文を3回音読**。3回目は翌日の「音読」の時間に。

blocks.title: 単語セットのやり方（1セット10分）
blocks.md:
1. 右の意味をかくして、左の英語を見て意味を言う（1周目）。言えなかった語に☐チェック。
2. チェックした語だけ、**英語→意味→英語**の順で3回書く。
3. 翌日、そのセットのチェック語だけ再テスト（前の日のセットの復習は「単語総復習」の日にまとめて）。
- 品詞：名＝名詞、動＝動詞、形＝形容詞、副＝副詞、前＝前置詞、接＝接続詞。
- 発音がむずかしい語は音読の日に先生や家族に確認。**書けなくても読めて意味がわかれば長文は読めます**。まず「読める」を優先。

blocks.title: 北辰のリスニング（28点）の形
blocks.md:
| 問題 | 形式 | 配点 | 放送 |
|:--:|:--|--:|:--|
| No.1〜3 | 短い対話＋質問 → 絵・表から選ぶ | 各2点＝6点 | 2回 |
| No.4〜5 | 短い対話＋質問 → 英語の選択肢ア〜エ | 各2点＝4点 | 2回 |
| No.6 | 長めの対話 → (1)(2)(3) の質問に合う答えをア〜エから | 各3点＝9点 | 2回 |
| No.7 | 英文（スピーチ・案内など）→ メモの空所に**英語1語** | 各3点＝9点 | 2回 |

blocks.title: 得点を安定させる7つの技
blocks.md:
1. **先読み**：放送が始まる前（説明が読まれている間）に、No.1〜3の絵と、No.6・No.7の選択肢・メモを見る。「時刻？場所？人？物？」と**何を聞き取るかを決めてから**聞く。
2. **1回目は答えを決める、2回目は確認**。1回目で聞き取れなくても、2回目があるとわかっていれば落ち着ける。
3. **数・曜日・時刻・値段はメモ**：数字は聞いた瞬間に書く。thirteen（13）と thirty（30）、fifteen と fifty の聞き分けはアクセント（-teen は後ろが強い）。
4. **対話の「最後の発言」に答えがあることが多い**。ただし途中の「変更」（At first … but …／Actually …／Sorry, I can't … so …）に注意。
5. **No.6・No.7は選択肢の語がそのまま放送に出るとは限らない**。言いかえ（buy ＝ get、begin ＝ start、by bike ＝ ride a bike）を意識。
6. **No.7の単語記述**は、**メモの前後の語から品詞と形を予想**（on ( ) → 曜日、at ( ) → 時刻、( ) years old → 数、bring ( ) → 名詞）。**複数形の s・過去形の ed・大文字（曜日・月）**を落とさない。
7. わからない問題は**必ずどれかにマーク**して次へ。放送はどんどん進む。引きずらない。

blocks.title: 毎日10分の「音読・シャドーイング」（LS）
blocks.md:
1. 前回のリスニング原稿（No.6かNo.7）を、意味を確認しながら**音読3回**。
2. 家族に読んでもらう（または読み上げアプリで流す）音声のすぐ後を追いかけて言う（**シャドーイング**）2回。
3. 最後に原稿を見ずに、聞くだけで内容が追えるか確認。
- リスニングの点が伸びる一番の近道は「自分で言える英文を増やす」ことです。

blocks.title: 家の人へ（放送のしかた）
blocks.md:
- 原稿は**ふつうの速さで、はっきり**と読んでください。各問題の英文は**2回**、間に3秒ほどあけます。問題と問題の間は10秒あけます。
- 読み上げアプリ（スマホの「読み上げ」機能や翻訳アプリの音声）を使う場合、原稿の英文部分をコピーして再生してください。
- 「Question:」の部分も読みます。No.7は英文のあとに「Question: 空所に入る語を書きなさい」は言わず、英文を2回読むだけでOKです。

blocks.title: 放送原稿（読み手用・各2回）
blocks.md:
**No.1**
A: What time does the movie start, Ken?
B: It starts at eight. Let's meet at the station thirty minutes before that.
A: OK. See you then.
Question: What time will they meet at the station?

**No.2**
A: Happy birthday, Mika! This is for you.
B: Thank you, Dad! Oh, it's a T-shirt with a cat on it. I love cats!
A: I'm glad you like it. I wanted to buy a cap, but I couldn't find a nice one.
Question: What did Mika get from her father?

**No.3**
A: How do you go to school, Lucy?
B: I usually walk, but it's raining today, so my mother will take me by car. How about you?
A: I ride my bike every day, even on rainy days.
Question: How does Lucy usually go to school?

**No.4**
A: Hi, Yumi. Can you help me with my math homework after school?
B: Sorry, Tom. I have to go to the library today. But I can help you tomorrow.
A: Thanks. Then I'll call you tomorrow.
Question: What will Yumi do today?

**No.5**
A: You were late for school this morning, Kenta. Did you miss the bus?
B: No. My alarm clock didn't ring, so I got up at eight.
A: That's too bad.
Question: Why was Kenta late for school?

**No.6**
A: Hi, Emma. Do you have any plans for this weekend?
B: Hi, Daiki. Not yet. Why?
A: I'm going to the city museum on Sunday afternoon. They have a special show about dinosaurs. Would you like to come with me?
B: Sounds interesting! But I have piano practice on Sunday afternoon. How about Sunday morning?
A: Sunday morning is fine. The museum opens at nine. Let's meet at the station at nine thirty.
B: OK. How much is the ticket?
A: It's five hundred yen for students. Oh, and bring your camera. We can take pictures in the show.
B: Great. I'll bring it. See you on Sunday!
Question (1): When will they go to the museum?
Question (2): Where will they meet?
Question (3): What does Daiki tell Emma to bring?

**No.7**
Hello, everyone. This is your homework for next week. Please write about your favorite season. Tell me why you like it. You must write more than five sentences. Please bring your paper on Monday. If you have any questions, come and see me after class. Thank you.

blocks.title: 解答・解説
blocks.md:
| 番号 | 答え | 解説 |
|:--:|:--:|:--|
| No.1 | イ | 映画は8時開始。その30分前に会う→7:30。「thirty minutes before that」を聞き取る |
| No.2 | イ | 実際にもらったのはTシャツ。「wanted to buy a cap」はひっかけ |
| No.3 | エ | usually walk（今日だけ車）。「今日」ではなく「ふだん」を聞かれている |
| No.4 | イ | 今日は図書館に行く。手伝うのは明日 |
| No.5 | ウ | 目覚まし時計が鳴らず8時に起きた→got up late |
| No.6(1) | ウ | 日曜午後はピアノ→日曜午前に変更 |
| No.6(2) | ア | Let's meet at the station |
| No.6(3) | ウ | bring your camera |
| No.7 | (1) season (2) five (3) Monday | 「favorite season」「more than five sentences」「on Monday」。Monday は大文字で |

blocks.md:
**No.1〜No.3**

No.1　ア a pencil　　イ an eraser　　ウ a ruler　　エ a dictionary

No.2　ア 2 hours　　イ 3 hours　　ウ 4 hours　　エ 5 hours

No.3　ア the library　　イ the gym　　ウ the music room　　エ the cafeteria

**No.4〜No.5**

No.4　ア She wants to be a nurse.　　イ She wants to be a teacher.　　ウ She wants to be a doctor.　　エ She wants to be a pilot.

No.5　ア By car.　　イ By train.　　ウ By bus.　　エ By plane.

**No.6**

(1)　ア Because she wanted to buy a book.　　イ Because she had to return a book.　　ウ Because she wanted to study.　　エ Because she wanted to meet Bob.

(2)　ア Japanese history.　　イ World history.　　ウ Japanese food.　　エ Old temples.

(3)　ア Go to Nara together.　　イ Study together.　　ウ Visit a museum.　　エ Read the same book.

**No.7**

:::memo メモ：Ken's speech about his grandfather
- His grandfather is (　1　) years old
- He goes (　2　) every morning with his dog
- His words: "Don't be (　3　) of making mistakes."

blocks.title: 放送原稿（各2回）
blocks.md:
**No.1**
A: Can I borrow your eraser, Mai?
B: Sorry, I'm using it now. Do you need a ruler, too?
A: No, thank you. Just an eraser.
Question: What does the boy want to borrow?

**No.2**
A: How long did you study yesterday, Kenji?
B: I studied for two hours in the morning and three hours in the evening.
A: Five hours! That's great.
Question: How long did Kenji study yesterday?

**No.3**
A: Where is Nick? He is not in the classroom.
B: He is practicing the guitar in the music room. The gym is being used by the basketball team.
A: I see. I'll go to the music room.
Question: Where is Nick now?

**No.4**
A: What do you want to be in the future, Yuki?
B: I wanted to be a teacher, but now I want to be a nurse. My aunt is a nurse, and I respect her.
A: That's a good dream.
Question: What does Yuki want to be now?

**No.5**
A: How did you go to Osaka, Tom?
B: I wanted to go by plane, but the tickets were expensive. So I took the train.
A: How long did it take?
B: About two and a half hours.
Question: How did Tom go to Osaka?

**No.6**
A: Hi, Bob. Why are you at the library on Sunday?
B: Hi, Nana. I had to return this book. It's about Japanese history. I'm interested in the old temples in Nara.
A: Really? I went to Nara last year with my family. There are many old temples and a lot of deer in the park.
B: I want to go there. Do you have any pictures?
A: Yes, I have many. Why don't we go there together during the winter vacation? My father can take us by car.
B: That would be great! I'll ask my parents.
A: OK. By the way, I'm here to study for the test. Would you like to study together?
B: Sure. Let's find a table.
Question (1): Why did Bob come to the library?
Question (2): What is Bob's book about?
Question (3): What does Nana ask Bob to do during the winter vacation?

**No.7**
Hello, everyone. Today I'll talk about my grandfather. He is seventy-five years old, but he is very active. He goes jogging every morning with his dog. He also grows vegetables in his garden. When I was worried about my test, he said to me, "Don't be afraid of making mistakes. You can learn from them." I always remember his words. I respect my grandfather very much. Thank you.

blocks.title: 手順
blocks.md:
1. **日本語のメモを先に読む**。何を伝えるメール／お知らせなのかをつかむ（日付・時間・場所・持ち物・お願いごと）。
2. 英文の空所の**前後**を見て「入る語の品詞と形」を決める（前置詞のあと→名詞／be動詞のあと→形容詞・分詞／to のあと→原形）。
3. メモの日本語の**対応する部分**を探して、英語にする。**1語指定なら1語**（複数形・過去形・大文字に注意）。
4. 選択問題は、前後の文とのつながり（理由→because／追加→also／対比→but）で判断。

- 10月に日本に来るのを楽しみにしている
- 10月は天気がよく、涼しい → 軽い上着を持ってくるといい
- 学校には自転車で通う（駅から10分）
- 10月20日に学校祭がある → 一緒に楽しもう
:::

Hi Emma,

I'm looking forward to ［A］ you in Japan next month. In October, the weather is nice and cool in Saitama, so you should bring a light jacket. We go to school by ［B］. It takes about ten minutes from the station. Our school festival will be held on October ［C］. ［D］ I'm sure you will enjoy it. See you soon!

［D］　ア I'm sorry I can't go.　イ Let's enjoy it together.　ウ I have never been there.　エ It was very fun.

blocks.title: 手順
blocks.md:
1. **設問を先に見る**：語形変化（どの動詞か）、並べ替え（前後の文）、英問英答（何を聞かれているか）を確認。
2. 本文は**段落ごと**に「だれが・何をした・どう思った」をメモ（日本語で3語程度）。
3. 語形変化は**前後の語**で判断（前に be → -ing か過去分詞／前に have → 過去分詞／yesterday → 過去形／to → 原形）。
4. 英問英答は、**質問の語順を使って答える**：Why did … ? → Because … ／ What did … ? → He (She) …。主語と動詞を必ず書く。

blocks.title: 次の英文は、中学生の Kenta が書いたスピーチ原稿です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
Last summer, I joined a clean-up event at the river near my town for the first time. My friend Sho asked me to come, so I said yes. To tell the truth, I was not interested in the event at first. I just wanted to spend the morning with my friend.

On the day of the event, about fifty people ①( gather ) at the river at eight in the morning. There were children, high school students, and elderly people. We were given gloves and bags, and we started to pick up trash along the river. I was surprised because there was so much trash. We found plastic bottles, cans, and even a bicycle! 

After two hours, the river looked very different. An old man who lives near the river said to us, "Thank you. ②( この川は40年前はとてもきれいでした。 ) I hope it will be clean again." His words ③( move ) me. I realized that the river was important to many people.

Now I join the event every month. I also started to carry my own bottle instead of ( ④ ) plastic bottles. I want to tell you one thing. You don't have to do something big. Small actions by many people can change our town.

blocks.title: 問い
blocks.question_md:
問1　①③の（　）内の語を、それぞれ適切な形に直して書きなさい。【各2点】

問2　下線部②の日本語を、（　）内の語を並べかえて英語にしなさい。 ( was / clean / very / this river ) forty years ago.【4点】

問3　（④）に入る最も適切な語をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】　ア buy　イ bought　ウ buying　エ to buy

問4　次の質問に英語で答えなさい。 Why was Kenta surprised at the river?【4点】

問5　本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア Kenta was very interested in the event before he joined it.
イ About fifty people cleaned the river for two hours.
ウ The old man said the river was dirty forty years ago.
エ Kenta thinks that only big actions can change the town.
blocks.answer_md:
問1　① gathered（On the day of the event ＝ 過去）　③ moved（His words moved me ＝ 感動させた）
問2　This river was very clean forty years ago.
問3　ウ（instead of ＋ -ing：前置詞のあとは動名詞）
問4　Because there was so much trash.（（例）Because he found a lot of trash there. も可）
問5　イ（ア：最初は興味がなかった／ウ：40年前はきれいだった／エ：小さな行動でも変えられる）

blocks.title: 次の英文は、中学生の Saki が英語の授業で書いた作文です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
My grandmother lives in a small village in Nagano. Every summer, I stay at her house for a week. She is eighty years old, but she still ①( grow ) vegetables in her field. She gets up at five every morning and works in the field before breakfast.

Last summer, I helped her for the first time. It was very hot, and my back hurt after only one hour. But my grandmother kept working with a smile. I asked her, "Why do you work so hard every day?" She said, "Because I want to give fresh vegetables to my family and neighbors. When people say 'delicious,' I feel happy."

That evening, we ②( 彼女が育てた野菜でカレーを作りました。 ) The vegetables were sweet and fresh. I have never ③( eat ) such a delicious curry. I understood why she works so hard.

Now I have a small garden at home, and I ( ④ ) tomatoes and cucumbers there. Growing vegetables is not easy, but I enjoy it. Next summer, I want to show my vegetables to my grandmother.

blocks.title: 問い
blocks.question_md:
問1　①③の（　）内の語を、それぞれ適切な形に直して書きなさい。【各2点】

問2　下線部②の日本語を、（　）内の語を並べかえて英語にしなさい。 We ( curry / with / made / the vegetables ) she grew.【4点】

問3　（④）に入る最も適切な語をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】　ア am growing　イ grew　ウ have grown　エ was growing

問4　次の質問に英語で答えなさい。 Why does Saki's grandmother work hard every day?【4点】

問5　本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア Saki's grandmother stopped working in the field because she is old.
イ Saki helped her grandmother for a week without any trouble.
ウ Saki's grandmother feels happy when people enjoy her vegetables.
エ Saki wants to buy vegetables for her grandmother next summer.
blocks.answer_md:
問1　① grows（still ＋現在の習慣。主語 She → 三単現）　③ eaten（have never ＋過去分詞）

blocks.title: 次の英文は、中学生の Ryo が書いた、修学旅行についてのレポートです。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
Our school trip to Nikko was in May. Before the trip, our class made groups of five, and each group ①( choose ) a place to visit. My group chose Toshogu Shrine because we wanted to see the famous carvings of the three monkeys.

On the first day, we visited the shrine. A guide told us about its history. It was ②( 約400年前に建てられました。 ) I was surprised that the buildings were still so beautiful. The guide said that many people have worked hard to keep them for a long time.

On the second day, we went to a lake in the mountains. The water was clear, and we could see fish ③( swim ) in it. We had lunch by the lake. My friend Taku took a lot of pictures. He said, "I want to be a photographer in the future."

The trip taught me two things. First, old things stay beautiful ( ④ ) people take care of them. Second, traveling with friends makes memories that last a long time. I will never forget this trip.

blocks.md:
One Sunday afternoon, I was walking to the library when I saw a woman with a big map near the station. She looked worried. I wanted to help her, but I was afraid of ①( speak ) English. I stood there for a minute. Then I remembered my teacher's words: "Don't worry about mistakes. Just try."

I walked to her and said, "May I help you?" She smiled and said she was looking for the art museum. I knew the museum well because I go there with my father. ②( 私は彼女に駅から博物館への道を教えました。 ) My English was not perfect, but she understood me.

She said, "Thank you. You are very kind." Then she told me that she came from Canada and was traveling in Japan alone. We talked for ten minutes. She ③( show ) me some pictures of her city. I was happy because I could communicate in English.

Since that day, I ( ④ ) English harder. I want to talk with more people from other countries. Now I understand that the most important thing is not perfect English. It is the courage to speak.

blocks.title: 手順
blocks.md:
1. 会話文は【1】〜【4】に分かれ、それぞれのあとに設問がある。**【1】を読んだら【1】の設問を解く**、の順で進める（全部読んでから解かない）。
2. **適文補充**は、空所の**直前の発言と直後の発言**を見る。質問→答え、提案→返事、のペアを探す。
3. **指示語（it / that / this / they）**は、直前の文の名詞や内容を指す。当てはめて意味が通るか確認。
4. **英作文（2文以上）**は、会話の流れに合わせて「自分の意見＋理由」。難しい単語を使わない。

blocks.title: 次は、中学生の Hana と、ALTの Mr. Davis の会話です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
**【1】**
Hana: Hello, Mr. Davis. Do you have time now?
Mr. Davis: Sure, Hana. What's up?
Hana: Our class is going to make a poster about our town for the English event next month. I want to introduce our town's summer festival, but I don't know how to start.
Mr. Davis: That sounds like a good topic. ( ① )
Hana: It is held every August. About ten thousand people come to see the fireworks.
Mr. Davis: Ten thousand! That's a lot. Have you ever been to a festival in another country?
Hana: No, I haven't. Are there festivals like this in your country?

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
blocks.md: ア When is the festival held?　イ Why don't you go to the festival?　ウ How many posters do you need?　エ Who made the poster?

**【2】**
Mr. Davis: Yes. In my hometown in Australia, we have a big festival in January. It's summer there in January.
Hana: Summer in January? That's interesting!
Mr. Davis: People enjoy music and food outside. ②It is very popular with families. Many people bring their own chairs and sit on the grass.
Hana: In Japan, many people wear *yukata* at summer festivals. Do people wear special clothes at your festival?
Mr. Davis: No, they don't. They wear T-shirts and shorts because it's very hot. ( ③ ) I think that's a nice difference.

blocks.title: 問2　下線部②の It が指すものを、本文中から英語3語で抜き出しなさい。【3点】
blocks.md:
問3　（③）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア I have a yukata, too.　イ I didn't know that Japanese people wear yukata.　ウ Wearing yukata sounds beautiful.　エ It is cold in Australia in January.

**【3】**
Hana: I want to put some pictures on the poster. ④( どの写真を使えばよいかわかりません。 )
Mr. Davis: Well, a picture of the fireworks is a must. And a picture of people wearing yukata will be good, too. People from other countries want to see how Japanese people enjoy the festival.
Hana: I see. Then I'll ask my father. He takes a lot of pictures every year.
Mr. Davis: Good. Also, write short sentences. People don't read long sentences on a poster.
Hana: OK. I'll write about the date, the place, and the fireworks.

blocks.title: 問4　下線部④の日本語を、（　）内の語を並べかえて英語にしなさい。 I don't know ( to / which / use / pictures ).【4点】
blocks.md: 問5　Mr. Davis がポスターについてハナに助言したことを、日本語で2つ書きなさい。【各2点＝4点】

**【4】**
Mr. Davis: By the way, why did you choose the festival for your poster?
Hana: Because it is my favorite event. When I was small, my grandmother took me there every year. ⑤I want people from other countries to know about it.
Mr. Davis: That's a great reason. Please tell that story on the poster, too.
Hana: I'll try. Thank you very much, Mr. Davis. ( ⑥ )
Mr. Davis: Of course. Come and show it to me anytime.

blocks.title: 問6　下線部⑤を日本語にしなさい。【3点】
blocks.question_md:
問7　（⑥）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア Can I show you the poster when I finish it?　イ Did you go to the festival with me?　ウ Shall I make a poster for you?　エ May I go to Australia with you?

問8　本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア Hana has been to a festival in Australia.　イ In Mr. Davis's hometown, people wear yukata at the festival.　ウ Hana's father takes pictures at the festival every year.　エ Mr. Davis chose the festival for Hana's poster.

問9　あなたが外国の人に紹介したい日本の行事や文化は何ですか。次の書き出しに続けて、**2文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【4点】
I want to introduce ( ) to people from other countries.
[[lines:3]]
blocks.answer_md:
問1　ア（直後にハナが「8月に開かれる」と答えている）
問2　a big festival（【2】最初の Mr. Davis の発言。「1月の大きな祭り」が家族連れに人気）
問3　ウ（ゆかたの話を受けて「すてきだね」→ 次の「いいちがいだと思う」につながる）
問4　I don't know which pictures to use.（疑問詞＋名詞＋to＋原形）
問5　（例）花火の写真とゆかたを着た人々の写真をのせること。／短い文で書くこと。（「日付・場所・花火について書く」はハナ自身の案なので不可）
問6　私は他の国の人々にそれ（この祭り）について知ってほしいです。
問7　ア（Of course. Come and show it to me anytime. につながる）
問8　ウ（【3】He takes a lot of pictures every year.）
問9　（例）I want to introduce *origami* to people from other countries. It is a traditional Japanese art of folding paper. We can make many things such as cranes and flowers with only one piece of paper.

items.label: 問7
items.q:
（⑥）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア Can I show you the poster when I finish it?　イ Did you go to the festival with me?　ウ Shall I make a poster for you?　エ May I go to Australia with you?
items.a: ア（Of course. Come and show it to me anytime. につながる）

items.label: 問8
items.q:
本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア Hana has been to a festival in Australia.　イ In Mr. Davis's hometown, people wear yukata at the festival.　ウ Hana's father takes pictures at the festival every year.　エ Mr. Davis chose the festival for Hana's poster.
items.a: ウ（【3】He takes a lot of pictures every year.）

items.label: 問9
items.q:
あなたが外国の人に紹介したい日本の行事や文化は何ですか。次の書き出しに続けて、**2文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【4点】
I want to introduce ( ) to people from other countries.
[[lines:3]]
items.a: （例）I want to introduce *origami* to people from other countries. It is a traditional Japanese art of folding paper. We can make many things such as cranes and flowers with only one piece of paper.

blocks.title: 次は、中学生の Kota と、アメリカからの留学生 Lily の会話です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
**【1】**
Lily: Kota, what's in that box? It looks heavy.
Kota: These are my old books. I'm going to take them to the school library. Our library collects used books and sends them to children in other countries.
Lily: ( ① )
Kota: About five years ago, I think. My sister was in this school then, and she joined the project.
Lily: That's wonderful. I have some books in English at home. Can I bring them, too?
Kota: Of course! Books in English will be very useful.

blocks.md: ア How many books do you have?　イ When did the library start the project?　ウ Where is the library?　エ Why do you have a box?

**【2】**
Lily: How do the books get to the children?
Kota: A volunteer group in the city collects the books from schools. Then ②they send the books to schools in Asia and Africa by ship.
Lily: By ship? ( ③ )
Kota: About two months. It's slow, but it's much cheaper than sending them by plane.
Lily: I see. I hope the children will enjoy reading my books.

**【3】**

Kota: That's a good idea. Let's talk to Ms. Tanaka, the library teacher, tomorrow.
Lily: OK. I'll make a poster in English tonight.
Kota: Then I'll make one in Japanese. We can put both posters on the wall.

blocks.title: 問4　下線部④の日本語を、（　）内の語を並べかえて英語にしなさい。 I think ( help / can / we / collect ) books, too.【4点】

Lily: Really? What happened to the book?
Kota: It's in this box. ⑤At first I didn't want to give it away, but I want another child to enjoy it now.
Lily: I think the book will make a child in another country very happy.
Kota: I hope so. ( ⑥ )
Lily: Yes. Reading is a bridge between people.

ア Books can connect people around the world.　イ I don't like reading books.　ウ The elephant was very big.　エ I will buy the book again tomorrow.

ア Kota's sister started the book project five years ago.　イ The books are sent to other countries by plane.　ウ Lily will bring her English books to the library.　エ Kota has read his favorite book only once.

blocks.title: 次は、中学生の Yui と、カナダからの留学生 Ben の、給食の時間の会話です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
**【1】**
Ben: Yui, this is my first school lunch in Japan. Everyone eats the same food together in the classroom. In Canada, we bring our own lunch or buy it at the cafeteria.
Yui: Really? In Japan, most elementary and junior high schools have school lunch. We call it *kyushoku*.
Ben: ( ① )
Yui: The students do. Every week, some students in each class serve the food to their classmates. We wear white clothes and masks.
Ben: That's interesting. So the students learn to work together.

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
blocks.md: ア Who serves the food?　イ What time do you eat?　ウ Where do you buy it?　エ Which food do you like?

**【2】**
Yui: Today's lunch is curry and rice, a salad, and milk. Do you like it?
Ben: Yes, it's delicious. ②Is it made at school?
Yui: Yes. There is a kitchen in our school. The cooks start cooking early in the morning for about six hundred students.
Ben: Six hundred! ( ③ )
Yui: I think so, too. Also, a nutritionist plans the menu. She thinks about our health, so the lunch has a lot of vegetables.

blocks.title: 問2　下線部②を日本語にしなさい。【3点】
blocks.md:
問3　（③）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア I can't eat so much.　イ They must work very hard.　ウ The kitchen is very small.　エ I want to cook it tomorrow.

**【3】**
Ben: In Canada, my lunch was often a sandwich and an apple. I sometimes bought pizza at the cafeteria.
Yui: Pizza for lunch sounds nice!
Ben: But I didn't eat many vegetables. Now I think Japanese school lunch is good for our health. ④( 私は毎日ちがう食べ物を試すことができます。 )
Yui: I'm glad you think so. Some students don't like vegetables, but our teacher says, "Try one bite."
Ben: One bite. That's a good way.

blocks.title: 問4　下線部④の日本語を、（　）内の語を並べかえて英語にしなさい。 I ( try / can / food / different ) every day.【4点】
blocks.md: 問5　Ben がカナダで食べていた昼食について、本文の内容に合うように日本語で書きなさい。【4点】

**【4】**
Yui: After lunch, we clean the classroom together. That is also a part of school life in Japan.
Ben: I heard about it. In Canada, cleaning staff clean the school.
Yui: ⑤Some people say students should not clean, but I think cleaning teaches us to take care of our school.
Ben: I agree. I'll try it today. ( ⑥ )
Yui: Sure. First, let's move the desks to the back of the room.

blocks.title: 問6　下線部⑤を日本語にしなさい。【3点】
blocks.question_md:
問7　（⑥）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア Can you tell me what to do?　イ Do I have to buy a lunch?　ウ Why don't you go home?　エ Where is the cafeteria?

問8　本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア In Canada, students usually eat school lunch in the classroom.　イ The cooks at Yui's school make lunch for about six hundred students.　ウ Ben doesn't think Japanese school lunch is good.　エ In Canada, students clean their school every day.

問9　あなたは、学校で「生徒が自分で教室をそうじすること」についてどう思いますか。あなたの考えを、理由を含めて**2文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【4点】
[[lines:3]]
blocks.answer_md:
問1　ア（直後「The students do.」＝生徒が配膳する）
問2　それは学校で作られているのですか。
問3　イ（600人分を朝早くから作る → 「とても大変にちがいない」→ I think so, too.）
問4　I can try different food every day.
問5　サンドイッチとリンゴのことが多く、ときどきカフェテリアでピザを買っていた（野菜はあまり食べなかった）。
問6　生徒はそうじをすべきではないと言う人もいるが、私はそうじは学校を大切にすることを教えてくれると思う。
問7　ア（Sure. First, let's move the desks … と「やること」を教えている）
問8　イ
問9　（例）I think students should clean their classroom. If we clean it by ourselves, we will try to keep it clean. Also, we can learn to work together with our classmates.

blocks.title: 次は、中学生の Sora と、オーストラリアからの留学生 Mia が、買い物の帰りに話している会話です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
**【1】**
Mia: Sora, you didn't take a plastic bag at the store. Do you always bring your own bag?
Sora: Yes. In Japan, we have to pay for plastic bags at many stores now. So many people bring their own bags.
Mia: ( ① )
Sora: It started in 2020. At first, some people didn't like it, but now it's normal.
Mia: In Australia, many stores stopped giving plastic bags, too. I think it's a good change.

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
blocks.md: ア How much is the bag?　イ When did that start?　ウ Where did you buy the bag?　エ Why do you like plastic bags?

**【2】**
Sora: My science teacher told us that a lot of plastic goes into the sea every year. ②Some sea animals eat it and die.
Mia: That's sad. I saw a video about a sea turtle with a plastic bag in its mouth. It thought the bag was food.
Sora: ( ③ )
Mia: Yes. And plastic doesn't disappear for hundreds of years. So we should use less plastic.

blocks.title: 問2　下線部②を日本語にしなさい。【3点】
blocks.md:
問3　（③）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア I don't believe that.　イ Sea turtles like plastic bags.　ウ That's terrible.　エ Plastic is very useful.

**【3】**
Mia: What else can we do?
Sora: Well, I carry my own water bottle. ④( ペットボトルを買う必要がありません。 ) And I use a *furoshiki*, a Japanese cloth, to wrap things.
Mia: A furoshiki? I've seen one at a shop. It has a beautiful design.
Sora: You can use it many times. My grandmother gave me hers. She has used it for thirty years!
Mia: Thirty years! That's a great way to reduce waste.

blocks.title: 問4　下線部④の日本語を、（　）内の語を並べかえて英語にしなさい。 I ( have / buy / to / don't ) plastic bottles.【4点】
blocks.md: 問5　Sora がプラスチックを減らすためにしていることを、日本語で2つ書きなさい。【各2点＝4点】

**【4】**
Mia: I'd like to learn how to use a furoshiki. Can you teach me?
Sora: Sure. There are many ways to wrap things. ⑤It is difficult at first, but you can learn it quickly.
Mia: Great. Maybe I can show it to my family when I go back to Australia. ( ⑥ )
Sora: That's a good idea. Let's practice at my house this weekend.
Mia: Thank you, Sora. I'm looking forward to it.

blocks.title: 問6　下線部⑤を日本語にしなさい。【3点】
blocks.question_md:
問7　（⑥）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア They will be surprised to see it.　イ They don't want to see it.　ウ I have never used a bag.　エ My family lives in Japan.

問8　本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア Sora always takes plastic bags at stores.　イ Mia thinks paying for plastic bags is a bad idea.　ウ Sora's grandmother has used her furoshiki for a long time.　エ Mia will teach Sora how to use a furoshiki.

問9　あなたが環境のためにしていること、またはしたいことは何ですか。理由を含めて**2文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【4点】
[[lines:3]]
blocks.answer_md:
問1　イ（直後「It started in 2020.」）
問2　海の動物の中にはそれ（プラスチック）を食べて死んでしまうものもいます。
問3　ウ（ウミガメの話を聞いて「ひどい」→ Yes. と続く）
問4　I don't have to buy plastic bottles.
問5　自分の水筒を持ち歩く。／風呂敷を使って物を包む。（自分の袋を持って行く、も可）
問6　それは最初はむずかしいが、すぐに覚えられます。
問7　ア（家族に見せる → 「見て驚くだろう」→ That's a good idea.）
問8　ウ
問9　（例）I try to use my own bag when I go shopping. Plastic bags are bad for the sea and the animals living there. I also want to turn off the lights when I leave a room to save energy.

items.label: 問7
items.q:
（⑥）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
ア They will be surprised to see it.　イ They don't want to see it.　ウ I have never used a bag.　エ My family lives in Japan.
items.a: ア（家族に見せる → 「見て驚くだろう」→ That's a good idea.）

items.label: 問8
items.q:
本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア Sora always takes plastic bags at stores.　イ Mia thinks paying for plastic bags is a bad idea.　ウ Sora's grandmother has used her furoshiki for a long time.　エ Mia will teach Sora how to use a furoshiki.

items.label: 問9
items.q:
あなたが環境のためにしていること、またはしたいことは何ですか。理由を含めて**2文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【4点】
[[lines:3]]
items.a: （例）I try to use my own bag when I go shopping. Plastic bags are bad for the sea and the animals living there. I also want to turn off the lights when I leave a room to save energy.

blocks.title: 手順
blocks.md:
1. 英作文（3文以上）の**テーマを先に読む**。本文を読みながら「自分ならこう答える」を考える。
2. 本文の設問（2問）は、本文中の語句を使って答える。
3. 英作文は **「意見 → 理由 → 具体例（または一言）」の3文**。書き出しの文が与えられていたら必ず使う。

blocks.title: 次の英文を読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
In my town, there is a small park called "Everyone's Garden." Ten years ago, it was just an empty place with a lot of trash. One day, an old woman living near the place started to grow flowers there. Her neighbors saw the flowers and began to help her. Now the garden has many kinds of flowers and vegetables, and about thirty people take care of it.

Every Sunday morning, the members meet at the garden. Children plant seeds, and elderly people teach them how to grow vegetables. In fall, they have a small festival and share the vegetables with the people in the town. The garden is not only a place for plants. It is also a place ( ① ) people can meet and talk.

The old woman says, "I just wanted to make the place beautiful. I didn't think it would become a place like this. Small actions can bring people together."

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な語をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
blocks.question_md:
ア which　イ where　ウ when　エ what

問2　この庭が「植物のための場所」であるだけでなく、どのような場所であると述べられていますか。日本語で書きなさい。【4点】

問3　あなたの町を、もっとよい場所にするために、あなたができることは何ですか。理由を含めて**3文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【5点】
[[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md:
問1　イ（a place where 人 can meet ＝ 人が会える場所。関係副詞 where は11月の範囲だが、「場所＋where」として選べるようにしておく）
問2　人々が集まって話をすることができる場所。
問3　（例）I can clean the park near my house with my friends. If the park is clean, more people will come and enjoy it. I also want to talk with elderly people in my town because they know a lot about its history.
**英作文の採点ポイント**：①3文以上あるか　②意見と理由がつながっているか　③三単現の s・時制・冠詞のミスがないか。

items.label: 問2
items.q: この庭が「植物のための場所」であるだけでなく、どのような場所であると述べられていますか。日本語で書きなさい。【4点】
items.a: 人々が集まって話をすることができる場所。

items.label: 問3

あなたの町を、もっとよい場所にするために、あなたができることは何ですか。理由を含めて**3文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【5点】
[[lines:4]]

（例）I can clean the park near my house with my friends. If the park is clean, more people will come and enjoy it. I also want to talk with elderly people in my town because they know a lot about its history.

blocks.title: 次は、留学生の Kate が、日本でのホストファミリーである Sato さんの家族に送ったメールです。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Sato,

I arrived home in London two days ago. Thank you very much for everything during my stay in Japan.

I have many good memories, but the best one is the day we made *mochi* together at New Year. I had never seen how mochi was made. When I hit the rice with the big wooden hammer, everyone laughed because I was so slow. But the mochi we made was the most delicious food I had in Japan.

I also remember that Mrs. Sato taught me how to write my name in *kanji*. I showed it to my friends here, and they were surprised. ( ① ) It was difficult, but I enjoyed learning it.

I want to visit Japan again in the future. Next time, I want to see the cherry blossoms in spring. Please come to London someday. I will show you around my city.

Love,
Kate

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
blocks.question_md:
ア They wanted to learn kanji, too.　イ They didn't like my name.　ウ I forgot how to write it.　エ Kanji is easy for me.

問2　Kate が日本で最も楽しかった思い出は何ですか。日本語で書きなさい。【4点】

問3　あなたが外国から来た人に体験してもらいたい日本の食べ物や行事は何ですか。理由を含めて**3文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【5点】
[[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md:
問1　ア（友達が驚いた → 「彼らも漢字を習いたがった」→ 難しかったが楽しかった、という流れ）
問2　正月に家族と一緒にもちを作ったこと。
問3　（例）I want people from other countries to try *okonomiyaki*. It is a Japanese food made with flour, eggs, cabbage, and meat. You can cook it at the table with your friends, so it is a lot of fun.

items.label: 問2
items.q: Kate が日本で最も楽しかった思い出は何ですか。日本語で書きなさい。【4点】
items.a: 正月に家族と一緒にもちを作ったこと。

items.label: 問3

あなたが外国から来た人に体験してもらいたい日本の食べ物や行事は何ですか。理由を含めて**3文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【5点】

blocks.title: 次の英文を読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
Reading picture books to children is a popular volunteer activity in Japan. My mother has done it at the city library for five years. Last month, I joined her for the first time.

I was nervous because I had to read in front of twenty children. Before the event, my mother gave me some advice. "Read slowly. Look at the children's faces. And enjoy the story yourself." I practiced at home many times.

On the day, I read a story about a little bear looking for his mother. When the bear found his mother at the end, a small girl in the front said, "I'm glad!" All the children smiled. At that moment, I understood why my mother has continued this activity for years. ( ① )

Now I read to the children every month. I still get nervous, but the children's smiles give me energy.

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】

ア She wanted to read many books herself.　イ Sharing a story makes both the reader and the listeners happy.　ウ The library is very quiet.　エ The children didn't listen to the story.

問2　筆者の母親が、イベントの前に与えた助言を日本語で2つ書きなさい。【4点】

問3　あなたがやってみたいボランティア活動は何ですか。理由を含めて**3文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【5点】
[[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md:
問1　イ（子どもたちの笑顔を見て「母が続ける理由がわかった」→ 物語を分かち合うことは読む人も聞く人も幸せにする）
問2　ゆっくり読むこと。／子どもたちの顔を見ること。（自分自身が物語を楽しむこと、も可）
問3　（例）I want to help elderly people in my town. Many of them live alone and feel lonely. I can visit them and talk with them, and I think they will be happy.

blocks.title: 次の英文を読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
Last week, I went to a new restaurant near the station with my family. When we sat down, a robot came to our table and said, "Welcome! Please order on the screen." We touched the screen to choose our food. Ten minutes later, the same robot brought our dishes to our table.

My little brother was very excited and said, "The robot is cool!" My father said, "Robots are useful because restaurants don't have enough workers these days." But my mother said, "I like talking with the staff. ( ① )"

I thought about it after dinner. Robots can carry dishes, but they cannot understand our feelings. When I was sick last year, a kind waitress at another restaurant brought me warm soup without being asked. I still remember her smile.

I think robots and people should work together. Robots can do simple work, and people can do the things that only people can do.

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
blocks.question_md:
ア Robots are better than people.　イ The food was not delicious.　ウ A restaurant needs a warm heart, too.　エ I want to buy a robot.

問2　筆者は、ロボットにできないことは何だと述べていますか。日本語で書きなさい。【4点】

問3　あなたは、レストランでロボットが働くことについてどう思いますか。あなたの考えを、理由を含めて**3文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【5点】
[[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md:
問1　ウ（母は「店員と話すのが好き」→ 「レストランにはあたたかい心も必要」）
問2　私たちの気持ちを理解すること。
問3　（例）I think it is a good idea. Robots can carry dishes quickly, so the staff can spend more time talking with customers. But I hope people will keep working at restaurants because their kindness makes us happy.

items.label: 問2
items.q: 筆者は、ロボットにできないことは何だと述べていますか。日本語で書きなさい。【4点】
items.a: 私たちの気持ちを理解すること。

items.label: 問3
items.q:
あなたは、レストランでロボットが働くことについてどう思いますか。あなたの考えを、理由を含めて**3文以上**の英語で書きなさい。【5点】
[[lines:4]]
items.a: （例）I think it is a good idea. Robots can carry dishes quickly, so the staff can spend more time talking with customers. But I hope people will keep working at restaurants because their kindness makes us happy.

blocks.context_md: ア Robots are better than people.　イ The food was not delicious.　ウ A restaurant needs a warm heart, too.　エ I want to buy a robot.

blocks.title: RR（長文の再読）のやり方
blocks.md:
- 間違えた大問3〜5を1本選び、**設問を見ずに本文だけを読んで、段落ごとに日本語で要約**（1段落1行）。
- そのあと、わからなかった単語に印をつけて、単語ノートへ。
- 最後に**音読1回**。長文は「知っている文章」を増やすほど読むのが速くなります。

blocks.title: 北辰の英作文はどこに出るか
blocks.md:
- **大問4の最後**：会話の流れに合わせて「あなたの考え」を**2文以上**（4〜6点）。
- **大問5の最後**：テーマについて「あなたの考え＋理由」を**3文以上**（5点前後）。
- 合計で約10点。**白紙は0点、書けば部分点**。「型」で書けば安定して7〜9点が取れます。

blocks.title: 3文の型（これだけ覚える）
blocks.md:
| 文 | 役割 | 使う形 |
|:--:|:--|:--|
| 1文目 | **意見・答え** | I think (that) … ／ I want to … ／ My favorite … is … ／ I agree (with …). |
| 2文目 | **理由** | … because … ／ There are two reasons. First, … ／ It is … for me to … |
| 3文目 | **具体例・一言** | For example, … ／ I also … ／ So I … ／ I hope … |

**書き出しが指定されていたら、その文をそのまま使って1文目にする。**

blocks.title: 減点されない7つのルール
blocks.md:
1. **知っている単語・文法だけで書く**。難しい語を使おうとしてスペルミスするより、簡単な語で正しく書く。
2. **主語と動詞を必ず入れる**。日本語のように主語を省略しない（× Like soccer. → ○ I like soccer.）
3. **三単現の s／過去形の ed／複数形の s** を、書いたあとに指でなぞってチェック。
4. **文の最初は大文字、最後はピリオド**。I は常に大文字。
5. **冠詞（a / the）と前置詞（in / on / at / to / for）**は、自信のある形だけ使う。迷ったら覚えている熟語ごと使う（in the morning、at school、on Sunday、go to the park）。
6. **and / because / so** で文をつなぐと自然になる。ただし1文を長くしすぎない（1文＝10語前後）。
7. 書いたら**必ず読み直す**（30秒）。「s・ed・大文字・ピリオド」の4点チェック。

blocks.title: 使える表現40
blocks.md:
**意見**：I think that 〜. ／ I don't think that 〜. ／ In my opinion, 〜. ／ I agree with 〜. ／ I'm for (against) 〜.
**理由**：〜 because … ／ There are two reasons. First, … Second, … ／ That's why 〜. ／ The reason is that 〜.
**例**：For example, 〜. ／ Such as 〜. ／ When I 〜, I … ／ Last year, I 〜.
**好み・希望**：My favorite 〜 is … ／ I like 〜 the best. ／ I want to 〜. ／ I would like to 〜. ／ I'm interested in 〜. ／ I'm good at 〜.
**経験**：I have 〜 (過去分詞) before. ／ I have never 〜. ／ When I was a child, I 〜.
**効果・結果**：〜 makes me happy. ／ It is good for our health. ／ We can learn 〜. ／ It helps us (to) 〜. ／ It is important for us to 〜.
**提案**：We should 〜. ／ Why don't we 〜? ／ Let's 〜. ／ It is a good idea to 〜.
**まとめ**：So I 〜. ／ I hope 〜. ／ I will try to 〜. ／ I'm sure (that) 〜. ／ That is my idea.
**つなぎ**：Also, 〜 ／ However, 〜 ／ On the other hand, 〜 ／ Then, 〜 ／ In addition, 〜

blocks.title: 例題：Which do you like better, summer or winter?（3文以上）
blocks.md:
**型どおりに書く**
1. I like summer better than winter.（意見）
2. I can swim in the sea with my friends in summer.（理由）
3. Also, we have a long vacation, so I can visit my grandparents.（具体例・追加）
→ 3文・約30語。難しい語はゼロ。これで満点です。

blocks.title: やり方
blocks.md:
- 各回、**3文以上**書く。書いたら W0 のルール7つでチェック → 下の解答例と比べる。
- 家族や先生に見てもらえるなら、**s・ed・大文字・ピリオド**の4点だけ見てもらう。
- 解答例と同じ内容である必要はありません。**自分の言葉で、簡単に、正しく**。

blocks.title: W1　あなたの好きな季節はいつですか。理由を含めて3文以上で書きなさい。
blocks.question_md: [[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md: My favorite season is winter. I like snow, and I can enjoy skiing with my family. Also, I like eating hot food such as *nabe* on cold days.

blocks.title: W2　あなたの将来の夢は何ですか。理由を含めて3文以上で書きなさい。
blocks.question_md: [[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md: I want to be a nurse in the future. When I was sick, a kind nurse helped me a lot. I want to help sick people like her, so I will study hard.

blocks.title: W3　外国から来た友達に、日本のどんな場所をすすめますか。理由を含めて3文以上で書きなさい。
blocks.question_md: [[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md: I want to take my friend to Kawagoe. There are many old buildings there, and we can feel the history of Japan. Also, we can eat delicious sweet potato snacks on the street.

blocks.title: W4　「本を読むこと」と「テレビを見ること」では、どちらがよいと思いますか。理由を含めて3文以上で書きなさい。
blocks.question_md: [[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md: I think reading books is better than watching TV. When I read, I can imagine the story in my head. Also, I can learn many new words from books.

blocks.title: W5　次の会話の（　）に合うように、2文以上の英語を書きなさい。
blocks.question_md:
Emma: What do you usually do on weekends?
You: ( )
[[lines:3]]
blocks.answer_md: I usually play basketball with my friends on Saturday. On Sunday, I stay home and read books or help my mother.

blocks.title: W6　あなたは、環境を守るためにどんなことをしていますか、またはしたいですか。理由を含めて3文以上で書きなさい。
blocks.question_md: [[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md: I carry my own water bottle every day. If I do so, I don't have to buy plastic bottles. I want to reduce plastic because it is bad for the sea and the animals.

blocks.title: W7　あなたが中学校生活で一番の思い出だと思うことは何ですか。3文以上で書きなさい。
blocks.question_md: [[lines:4]]
blocks.answer_md: My best memory is the chorus contest in my second year. Our class practiced every day after school for a month. We won first prize, and everyone cried with joy.

blocks.title: W8　次の会話の（　）に合うように、2文以上の英語を書きなさい。
blocks.question_md:
Mr. Brown: Why do you study English, Ken?
Ken: ( )
[[lines:3]]
blocks.answer_md: I study English because I want to travel around the world. If I can speak English, I can make friends with people from many countries.

blocks.title: ミス分類表（W1〜W8と模擬の英作文を見直して、当てはまるものに数を書く）
blocks.md:
| ミスの種類 | 回数 | 直し方 |
|:--|:--:|:--|
| 三単現の s 忘れ | | 主語が he / she / it のとき、動詞に丸をつけてから s |
| 時制（過去の話を現在形で） | | 「昨日・去年・was」があれば動詞は過去形 |
| 複数形の s 忘れ | | many / two / some のあとは s |
| 冠詞（a / the）の抜け | | 数えられる名詞の単数には a か the |
| 前置詞のまちがい | | 熟語ごと覚える（on Sunday, in the morning） |
| 語順（日本語の順で書いた） | | 主語→動詞→目的語→場所→時 |
| スペルミス | | 単語ノートへ。書いて3回 |
| 文の数が足りない | | 型（意見・理由・例）で必ず3文 |
| 大文字・ピリオド | | 見直しの4点チェック |

**いちばん多いミスを1つ選び、次の英作文ではそれだけを意識して書く**。1つずつ消していけば、10点満点に近づきます。

blocks.title: 模擬テストのやり方
blocks.md:
- **50分を計る**（リスニング約10分を含む）。リスニングは家の人に原稿を読んでもらうか、読み上げアプリで再生。
- 解く順番は本番と同じ：大問1（放送）→ 大問2 → 大問5の英作文 → 大問3 → 大問4。
- 終わったら採点し、大問ごとの得点を総合計画の記録表に書く。**直し**は翌日（M1R・M2R）。

blocks.title: 問題
blocks.md:
**No.1〜No.3**　対話と質問を聞いて、答えとして最も適切なものをア〜エから選びなさい。【各2点】

No.1　ア 8:00　　イ 8:15　　ウ 8:30　　エ 8:45

No.2　ア a book　　イ a cake　　ウ flowers　　エ a cup

No.3　ア the park　　イ the library　　ウ the museum　　エ the gym

**No.4〜No.5**【各2点】

No.4　ア He will go to the hospital.　　イ He will play in the game.　　ウ He will watch the game.　　エ He will practice soccer.

No.5　ア At 6:00.　　イ At 6:30.　　ウ At 7:00.　　エ At 7:30.

**No.6**【各3点】

(1)　ア Her mother.　　イ Her grandmother.　　ウ Her teacher.　　エ Her friend.

(2)　ア Two.　　イ Three.　　ウ Five.　　エ Ten.

(3)　ア Eat dinner together.　　イ Go to the flower shop.　　ウ Make a card.　　エ Buy a cake.

**No.7**　英文を聞いて、メモの空所（1）〜（3）に入る英語1語を書きなさい。【各3点】
:::memo メモ：Ms. Green's message
- The English speech contest will be held on November (　1　)
- Speeches must be about your (　2　)

:::

blocks.title: 放送原稿（各2回）
blocks.md:
**No.1**
A: Excuse me. What time does the museum open?
B: It opens at eight thirty. But you can wait in the garden from eight.
A: Thank you.
Question: What time does the museum open?

**No.2**
A: Tomorrow is Mom's birthday. I bought her a book. What about you, Kenji?
B: I'm going to buy some flowers after school.
A: Good. Let's give them to her together.
Question: What will Kenji buy for his mother?

**No.3**
A: Mike, let's play basketball in the park after school.
B: Sorry, I can't. I have to go to the library to return some books. Then I'll go to the gym for practice.
A: OK. See you tomorrow.
Question: Where will Mike go first after school?

**No.4**
A: Are you going to play in the soccer game tomorrow, Ryo?
B: No. I hurt my leg yesterday, so I'll watch the game from the bench.
A: That's too bad. I hope your leg gets better soon.
Question: What will Ryo do tomorrow?

**No.5**
A: Dad, what time will we leave for the airport tomorrow?
B: The plane leaves at nine, so let's leave home at six thirty.
A: OK. I'll set my alarm for six.
Question: What time will they leave home tomorrow?

**No.6**
A: Hi, Nana. You look busy. What are you doing?
B: Hi, Tom. I'm making a card for my grandmother. Her birthday is this Saturday.
A: That's nice. How old will she be?
B: She'll be seventy. My family is going to have a party for her at my house. My mother is going to cook her favorite food.
A: Sounds great. Will you give her a present?
B: Yes. My sister and I are going to buy her a scarf together. I'll go to the shop with my sister on Friday.
A: I'm sure she'll be happy.
B: I hope so. She has taught me a lot of things since I was small.
Question (1): Who is Nana making a card for?
Question (2): How many people will buy the scarf?
Question (3): What will Nana do on Friday?

**No.7**
Hello, everyone. This is a message from your English teacher, Ms. Green. The English speech contest will be held on November fifteenth in the school hall. Everyone can join. Your speech must be about your dream. It should be two or three minutes long. If you want to join, please write your speech and give the paper to me by next Friday. I'm looking forward to your speeches. Thank you.
