blocks.title: 次の英文は、中学生の Mio が書いたスピーチ原稿です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
When I was in elementary school, I didn't like vegetables. My mother tried many ways to make me eat them, but I always said no. One day, my grandfather said, "Why don't you grow vegetables with me?" I wasn't interested, but I ①( go ) to his field the next Sunday.

He gave me some small tomato plants. I planted them and watered them every morning. It was hard work, and sometimes I wanted to stop. But my grandfather said, "Plants grow slowly. ②( 待つことは大切です。 ) Be patient."

Two months later, my tomatoes turned red. When I ate one, I was surprised. It was sweet and delicious! I ate three tomatoes that day. My mother laughed and said, "You've changed."

Now I eat many kinds of vegetables. I also learned something important from my grandfather. If you keep ( ③ ) something, you will get a good result. This is true not only for growing vegetables but also for studying and sports. I have ④( keep ) his words in my heart since then.

blocks.title: 問い
blocks.md:
問1　①④の（　）内の語を、それぞれ適切な形に直して書きなさい。【各2点】

問2　下線部②の日本語を、（　）内の語を並べかえて英語にしなさい。 ( important / is / waiting ).【4点】

問3　（③）に入る最も適切な語をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】　ア do　イ did　ウ doing　エ to do

問4　次の質問に英語で答えなさい。 What did Mio's grandfather give her?【4点】

問5　本文の内容と合うものをア〜エから1つ選びなさい。【3点】
ア Mio liked vegetables when she was in elementary school.
イ Mio wanted to grow vegetables before her grandfather asked her.
ウ Mio's tomatoes turned red two months after she planted them.
エ Mio thinks her grandfather's words are true only for growing vegetables.

blocks.title: 次の英文を読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
Do you know how much food is thrown away in Japan every year? It is about five million tons. A lot of it is food that can still be eaten. This is called "food loss." 

There are many reasons for food loss. Stores throw away food that is not sold. At home, people buy too much food and forget to eat it. At restaurants, people order more than they can eat.

A junior high school in my city started a small project. The students made posters about food loss and put them in the school cafeteria. They also asked the cafeteria to make smaller lunches for students who cannot eat much. After three months, the amount of food thrown away at the school became half. ( ① )

We cannot solve this big problem alone, but each of us can do something small every day.

blocks.title: 問1　（①）に入る最も適切な文をア〜エから選びなさい。【3点】
blocks.question_md:

問2　筆者は、食品ロスが起こる理由として、家庭ではどのようなことが起きていると述べていますか。日本語で書きなさい。【4点】

blocks.title: 次の英文は、中学生の Taku が書いた作文です。これを読んで、あとの問いに答えなさい。
blocks.md:
My father is a bus driver. When I was small, I was proud of him because he could drive a big bus. But when I became a junior high school student, I stopped ①( talk ) about his job with my friends. I thought it was not a "cool" job.

One rainy morning, I took my father's bus to go to the city. An old woman got on the bus with a heavy bag. My father stopped the bus, stood up, and carried her bag to a seat. ②( 彼はバスの中のすべての人にほほえみかけました。 ) Some passengers said "thank you" when they got off. I saw their faces. They looked happy.

At that moment, I understood something. My father's job is not only ( ③ ) a bus. It is helping people go where they want to go, safely and happily. I felt proud of him again.

That night, I said to my father, "Your job is great." He looked surprised, and then he smiled. I have never ④( see ) such a happy smile on his face.

Have you ever heard of a "walking school bus"? It is not a real bus. It is a group of children walking to school together with some adults. The adults are usually parents or volunteers living in the town.

blocks.title: 本番直前チェック10（読むだけ）
blocks.md:
1. 主語が he / she / it で現在の話 → 動詞に **s**。
2. yesterday / last / ago → **過去形**。since / for → **現在完了**。now / Look! → **進行形**。
3. 前置詞（in, at, for, of, about, without）のあと → **-ing**。look forward to も **-ing**。
4. want / hope / decide / would like → **to ＋原形**。enjoy / finish / stop → **-ing**。
5. 「〜している人」→ **-ing** を名詞の後ろに。「〜された物」→ **過去分詞** を名詞の後ろに。
6. 受け身は **be ＋過去分詞**。「〜によって」は by。
7. It is … **for** 人 to 〜。want / tell / ask 人 **to** 〜。let / make / help 人 **原形**。
8. 比較は **than**、最上級は **the ＋ -est / most**、同じくらいは **as … as**。
9. if / when の中は**未来でも現在形**。
10. 英作文は **意見・理由・例の3文**。書いたら s・ed・大文字・ピリオドをチェック。

- 放送が終わったら、**大問2 → 大問5の英作文 → 大問3 → 大問4**。1問2分で見切る。
- 最後の3分は、英作文の s・ed・大文字・ピリオドの見直しに使う。
